package xiangshan.backend.decode

import org.chipsalliance.cde.config.Parameters
import chisel3._
import chisel3.util._
import freechips.rocketchip.rocket.Instructions
import freechips.rocketchip.util.uintToBitPat
import utils._
import utility._
import xiangshan.ExceptionNO.illegalInstr
import xiangshan._
import xiangshan.backend.fu.fpu.FPU
import xiangshan.backend.fu.FuType
import freechips.rocketchip.rocket.Instructions._
import xiangshan.backend.Bundles.{DecodedInst, StaticInst}
import xiangshan.backend.decode.isa.bitfield.XSInstBitFields
import xiangshan.backend.fu.vector.Bundles.{VSew, VType, VLmul, Vl}
import yunsuan.VpermType
import chisel3.util.experimental.decode.{QMCMinimizer, TruthTable, decoder}

class indexedLSUopTable(uopIdx:Int) extends Module {
  val src = IO(Input(UInt(4.W)))
  val outOffsetVs2 = IO(Output(UInt(3.W)))
  val outOffsetVd = IO(Output(UInt(3.W)))
  def genCsBundle_VEC_INDEXED_LDST(lmul:Int, emul:Int, uopIdx:Int): (Int, Int) ={
    // only consider non segment indexed load/store
    if (lmul < emul) {    // lmul < emul, uop num is depend on emul * nf
      var offset = 1 << (emul - lmul)
      for (i <- 0 until (1 << emul)) {
        if (uopIdx == i) {
          return (i, i / offset)
        }
      }
    } else {              // lmul > emul, uop num is depend on lmul * nf
      var offset = 1 << (lmul - emul)
      for (i <- 0 until (1 << lmul)) {
        if (uopIdx == i) {
          return (i / offset, i)
        }
      }
    }
    return (0, 0)
  }
  // strided load/store
  var combVemulNf : Seq[(Int, Int, Int, Int)] = Seq()
  for (emul <- 0 until 4) {
    for (lmul <- 0 until 4) {
      var offset = genCsBundle_VEC_INDEXED_LDST(lmul, emul, uopIdx)
      var offsetVs2 = offset._1
      var offsetVd = offset._2
      combVemulNf :+= (emul, lmul, offsetVs2, offsetVd)
    }
  }
  val out = decoder(QMCMinimizer, src, TruthTable(combVemulNf.map {
    case (emul, lmul, offsetVs2, offsetVd) =>
      (BitPat((emul << 2 | lmul).U(4.W)), BitPat((offsetVs2 << 3 | offsetVd).U(6.W)))
  }, BitPat.N(6)))
  outOffsetVs2 := out(5, 3)
  outOffsetVd := out(2, 0)
}

trait VectorConstants {
  val MAX_VLMUL = 8
  val VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL = 32 // 32~46  ->  15
  val VECTOR_COMPRESS = 1 // in v0 regfile
  val MAX_INDEXED_LS_UOPNUM = 64
}

class DecodeUnitCompInput(implicit p: Parameters) extends XSBundle {
  val simpleDecodedInst = new DecodedInst
  val uopInfo = new UopInfo
}

class DecodeUnitCompOutput(implicit p: Parameters) extends XSBundle {
  val complexDecodedInsts = Vec(RenameWidth, DecoupledIO(new DecodedInst))
}

class DecodeUnitCompIO(implicit p: Parameters) extends XSBundle {
  val redirect = Input(Bool())
  val csrCtrl = Input(new CustomCSRCtrlIO)
  val vtypeBypass = Input(new VType)
  // When the first inst in decode vector is complex inst, pass it in
  val in = Flipped(DecoupledIO(new DecodeUnitCompInput))
  val out = new DecodeUnitCompOutput
  val complexNum = Output(UInt(3.W))
}

/**
 * @author zly
 */
class DecodeUnitComp()(implicit p : Parameters) extends XSModule with DecodeUnitConstants with VectorConstants {
  val io = IO(new DecodeUnitCompIO)

  // alias
  private val inReady = io.in.ready
  private val inValid = io.in.valid
  private val inDecodedInst = WireInit(io.in.bits.simpleDecodedInst)
  private val inInstFields = io.in.bits.simpleDecodedInst.instr.asTypeOf(new XSInstBitFields)
  private val inUopInfo = io.in.bits.uopInfo
  private val outValids = io.out.complexDecodedInsts.map(_.valid)
  private val outReadys = io.out.complexDecodedInsts.map(_.ready)
  private val outDecodedInsts = io.out.complexDecodedInsts.map(_.bits)
  private val outComplexNum = io.complexNum

  val maxUopSize = MaxUopSize
  when (io.in.fire && io.in.bits.simpleDecodedInst.isVset) {
    when(inInstFields.RD === 0.U && inInstFields.RS1 === 0.U) {
      inDecodedInst.fuOpType := VSETOpType.keepVl(io.in.bits.simpleDecodedInst.fuOpType)
    }.elsewhen(inInstFields.RS1 === 0.U) {
      inDecodedInst.fuOpType := VSETOpType.setVlmax(io.in.bits.simpleDecodedInst.fuOpType)
    }
  }

  val latchedInst = RegEnable(inDecodedInst, inValid && inReady)
  val latchedUopInfo = RegEnable(inUopInfo, inValid && inReady)
  //input bits
  private val instFields: XSInstBitFields = latchedInst.instr.asTypeOf(new XSInstBitFields)

  val src1 = Cat(0.U(1.W), instFields.RS1)
  val src2 = Cat(0.U(1.W), instFields.RS2)
  val dest = Cat(0.U(1.W), instFields.RD)

  val nf    = instFields.NF
  val width = instFields.WIDTH(1, 0)

  //output of DecodeUnit
  val numOfUop = Wire(UInt(log2Up(maxUopSize).W))
  val numOfWB = Wire(UInt(log2Up(maxUopSize).W))
  val lmul = Wire(UInt(4.W))
  val isVsetSimple = Wire(Bool())

  val indexedLSRegOffset = Seq.tabulate(MAX_VLMUL)(i => Module(new indexedLSUopTable(i)))
  indexedLSRegOffset.map(_.src := 0.U)

  //pre decode
  lmul := latchedUopInfo.lmul
  isVsetSimple := latchedInst.isVset
  val vlmulReg = latchedInst.vpu.vlmul
  val vsewReg = latchedInst.vpu.vsew
  val vstartReg = latchedInst.vpu.vstart

  //Type of uop Div
  val typeOfSplit = latchedInst.uopSplitType
  val src1Type = latchedInst.srcType(0)
  val src1IsImm = src1Type === SrcType.imm
  val src1IsFp = src1Type === SrcType.fp

  val isVstore = FuType.isVStore(latchedInst.fuType)

  // exception generator
  val vecException = Module(new VecExceptionGen)
  vecException.io.inst := latchedInst.instr
  vecException.io.decodedInst := latchedInst
  vecException.io.vtype := latchedInst.vpu.vtype
  vecException.io.vstart := latchedInst.vpu.vstart
  val illegalInst = vecException.io.illegalInst

  numOfUop := latchedUopInfo.numOfUop
  numOfWB := latchedUopInfo.numOfWB

  //uops dispatch
  val s_idle :: s_active :: Nil = Enum(2)
  val state = RegInit(s_idle)
  val stateNext = WireDefault(state)
  val numDecodedUop = RegInit(0.U(log2Up(maxUopSize).W))
  val uopRes = RegInit(0.U(log2Up(maxUopSize).W))
  val uopResNext = WireInit(uopRes)
  val e64 = 3.U(2.W)
  val isUsSegment = instFields.MOP === 0.U && ((nf =/= 0.U && instFields.LUMOP === 0.U) || instFields.LUMOP === "b10000".U)
  val isIxSegment = instFields.MOP(0) === 1.U && nf =/= 0.U
  val isSdSegment = instFields.MOP === "b10".U && nf =/= 0.U

  //uop div up to maxUopSize
  val csBundle = Wire(Vec(maxUopSize, new DecodedInst))
  val fixedDecodedInst = Wire(Vec(maxUopSize, new DecodedInst))

  csBundle.foreach { case dst =>
    dst := latchedInst
    dst.numUops := latchedUopInfo.numOfUop
    dst.numWB := latchedUopInfo.numOfWB
    dst.exceptionVec(ExceptionNO.EX_II) := latchedInst.exceptionVec(ExceptionNO.EX_II) || illegalInst
    dst.firstUop := false.B
    dst.lastUop := false.B
    dst.vlsInstr := false.B
  }

  csBundle(0).firstUop := true.B
  csBundle(numOfUop - 1.U).lastUop := true.B

  // when vstart is not zero, the last uop will modify vstart to zero
  // therefore, blockback and flush pipe
  csBundle(numOfUop - 1.U).blockBackward := vstartReg =/= 0.U
  csBundle(0.U).flushPipe := vstartReg =/= 0.U

  switch(typeOfSplit) {
    is(UopSplitType.AMO_CAS_W) {
      csBundle(0).uopIdx := 0.U
      csBundle(0).fuOpType := Cat(1.U(3.W), LSUOpType.amocas_w)
      csBundle(0).lsrc(0) := 0.U
      csBundle(0).lsrc(1) := src2
      csBundle(0).rfWen := false.B
      csBundle(0).waitForward := true.B
      csBundle(0).blockBackward := false.B

      csBundle(1).uopIdx := 1.U
      csBundle(1).fuOpType := Cat(0.U(3.W), LSUOpType.amocas_w)
      csBundle(1).lsrc(0) := src1
      csBundle(1).lsrc(1) := dest
      csBundle(1).waitForward := false.B
      csBundle(1).blockBackward := true.B
    }
    is(UopSplitType.AMO_CAS_D) {
      csBundle(0).uopIdx := 0.U
      csBundle(0).fuOpType := Cat(1.U(3.W), LSUOpType.amocas_d)
      csBundle(0).lsrc(0) := 0.U
      csBundle(0).lsrc(1) := src2
      csBundle(0).rfWen := false.B
      csBundle(0).waitForward := true.B
      csBundle(0).blockBackward := false.B

      csBundle(1).uopIdx := 1.U
      csBundle(1).fuOpType := Cat(0.U(3.W), LSUOpType.amocas_d)
      csBundle(1).lsrc(0) := src1
      csBundle(1).lsrc(1) := dest
      csBundle(1).waitForward := false.B
      csBundle(1).blockBackward := true.B
    }
    is(UopSplitType.AMO_CAS_Q) {
      csBundle(0).uopIdx := 0.U
      csBundle(0).fuOpType := Cat(1.U(3.W), LSUOpType.amocas_q)
      csBundle(0).lsrc(0) := 0.U
      csBundle(0).lsrc(1) := src2
      csBundle(0).rfWen := false.B
      csBundle(0).waitForward := true.B
      csBundle(0).blockBackward := false.B

      csBundle(1).uopIdx := 1.U
      csBundle(1).fuOpType := Cat(0.U(3.W), LSUOpType.amocas_q)
      csBundle(1).lsrc(0) := src1
      csBundle(1).lsrc(1) := dest
      csBundle(1).waitForward := false.B
      csBundle(1).blockBackward := false.B

      csBundle(2).uopIdx := 2.U
      csBundle(2).fuOpType := Cat(3.U(3.W), LSUOpType.amocas_q)
      csBundle(2).lsrc(0) := 0.U
      csBundle(2).lsrc(1) := Mux(src2 === 0.U, 0.U, src2 + 1.U)
      csBundle(2).rfWen := false.B
      csBundle(2).waitForward := false.B
      csBundle(2).blockBackward := false.B

      csBundle(3).uopIdx := 3.U
      csBundle(3).fuOpType := Cat(2.U(3.W), LSUOpType.amocas_q)
      csBundle(3).lsrc(0) := 0.U
      csBundle(3).lsrc(1) := Mux(dest === 0.U, 0.U, dest + 1.U)
      csBundle(3).ldest := Mux(dest === 0.U, 0.U, dest + 1.U)
      csBundle(3).waitForward := false.B
      csBundle(3).blockBackward := true.B
    }
    is(UopSplitType.VSET) {
      // In simple decoder, rfWen and vecWen are not set
      when(isVsetSimple) {
        // Default
        // uop0 set rd, never flushPipe
        csBundle(0).fuType := FuType.vsetiwi.U
        csBundle(0).flushPipe := Mux(VSETOpType.isVsetvl(latchedInst.fuOpType), true.B, vstartReg =/= 0.U)
        csBundle(0).blockBackward := false.B
        csBundle(0).rfWen := true.B
        // uop1 set vl, vsetvl will flushPipe
        csBundle(1).ldest := Vl_IDX.U
        csBundle(1).vecWen := false.B
        csBundle(1).vlWen := true.B
        csBundle(1).flushPipe := false.B
        csBundle(1).blockBackward := Mux(VSETOpType.isVsetvl(latchedInst.fuOpType), true.B, vstartReg =/= 0.U)
        when(VSETOpType.isVsetvli(latchedInst.fuOpType) && dest === 0.U && src1 === 0.U) {
          // write nothing, uop0 is a nop instruction
          csBundle(0).rfWen := false.B
          csBundle(0).fpWen := false.B
          csBundle(0).vecWen := false.B
          csBundle(0).vlWen := false.B
          csBundle(1).fuType := FuType.vsetfwf.U
          csBundle(1).srcType(0) := SrcType.no
          csBundle(1).srcType(2) := SrcType.no
          csBundle(1).srcType(3) := SrcType.no
          csBundle(1).srcType(4) := SrcType.vp
          csBundle(1).lsrc(4) := Vl_IDX.U
        }.elsewhen(VSETOpType.isVsetvl(latchedInst.fuOpType) && dest === 0.U && src1 === 0.U) {
          // uop0: mv vtype gpr to vector region
          csBundle(0).srcType(0) := SrcType.xp
          csBundle(0).srcType(1) := SrcType.no
          csBundle(0).lsrc(0) := src2
          csBundle(0).lsrc(1) := 0.U
          csBundle(0).ldest := VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL.U
          csBundle(0).fuType := FuType.i2v.U
          csBundle(0).fuOpType := Cat(IF2VectorType.i2Vec(2, 0), e64)
          csBundle(0).rfWen := false.B
          csBundle(0).fpWen := false.B
          csBundle(0).vecWen := true.B
          csBundle(0).vlWen := false.B
          // uop1: uvsetvcfg_vv
          csBundle(1).fuType := FuType.vsetfwf.U
          // vl
          csBundle(1).srcType(0) := SrcType.no
          csBundle(1).srcType(2) := SrcType.no
          csBundle(1).srcType(3) := SrcType.no
          csBundle(1).srcType(4) := SrcType.vp
          csBundle(1).lsrc(4) := Vl_IDX.U
          // vtype
          csBundle(1).srcType(1) := SrcType.vp
          csBundle(1).lsrc(1) := VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL.U
          csBundle(1).vecWen := false.B
          csBundle(1).vlWen := true.B
          csBundle(1).ldest := Vl_IDX.U
        }.elsewhen(dest === 0.U) {
          // write nothing, uop0 is a nop instruction
          csBundle(0).rfWen := false.B
          csBundle(0).fpWen := false.B
          csBundle(0).vecWen := false.B
          csBundle(0).vlWen := false.B
        }.elsewhen(VSETOpType.isVsetvl(latchedInst.fuOpType)) {
          // because vsetvl may modified src2 when src2 == rd,
          // we need to modify vd in second uop to avoid dependency
          // uop0 set vl
          csBundle(0).fuType := FuType.vsetiwf.U
          csBundle(0).ldest := Vl_IDX.U
          csBundle(0).rfWen := false.B
          csBundle(0).vlWen := true.B
          // uop1 set rd
          csBundle(1).fuType := FuType.vsetiwi.U
          csBundle(1).ldest := dest
          csBundle(1).rfWen := true.B
          csBundle(1).vlWen := false.B
        }
        // use bypass vtype from vtypeGen
        csBundle(0).vpu.connectVType(io.vtypeBypass)
        csBundle(1).vpu.connectVType(io.vtypeBypass)
      }
    }
    is(UopSplitType.VEC_VDOT) {
      csBundle(0).lsrc(0) := src1
      csBundle(0).lsrc(1) := src2
      csBundle(0).lsrc(2) := dest
      // Full-register overwrite: neither arithmetic nor tail/mask merge reads
      // old vd. Clear before DecodeStage's auxiliary v0-source detection;
      // real vs1/vs2 aliases (including v0) remain normal vector sources.
      csBundle(0).srcType(2) := SrcType.no
      csBundle(0).ldest := dest
      csBundle(0).uopIdx := 0.U
    }
    is(UopSplitType.VEC_VVV) {
      for (i <- 0 until MAX_VLMUL) {
        csBundle(i).lsrc(0) := src1 + i.U
        csBundle(i).lsrc(1) := src2 + i.U
        csBundle(i).lsrc(2) := dest + i.U
        csBundle(i).ldest := dest + i.U
        csBundle(i).uopIdx := i.U
      }
    }
    is(UopSplitType.VEC_VFV) {
      /*
      f to vector move
       */
      csBundle(0).srcType(0) := SrcType.fp
      csBundle(0).srcType(1) := SrcType.imm
      csBundle(0).srcType(2) := SrcType.imm
      csBundle(0).lsrc(1) := 0.U
      csBundle(0).ldest := VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL.U
      csBundle(0).fuType := FuType.f2v.U
      csBundle(0).fuOpType := Cat(IF2VectorType.fDup2Vec(2, 0), vsewReg)
      csBundle(0).vecWen := true.B
      csBundle(0).vpu.isReverse := false.B
      /*
      LMUL
       */
      for (i <- 0 until MAX_VLMUL) {
        csBundle(i + 1).srcType(0) := SrcType.vp
        csBundle(i + 1).lsrc(0) := VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL.U
        csBundle(i + 1).lsrc(1) := src2 + i.U
        csBundle(i + 1).lsrc(2) := dest + i.U
        csBundle(i + 1).ldest := dest + i.U
        csBundle(i + 1).uopIdx := i.U
      }
    }
    is(UopSplitType.VEC_EXT2) {
      for (i <- 0 until MAX_VLMUL / 2) {
        csBundle(2 * i).lsrc(1) := src2 + i.U
        csBundle(2 * i).lsrc(2) := dest + (2 * i).U
        csBundle(2 * i).ldest := dest + (2 * i).U
        csBundle(2 * i).uopIdx := (2 * i).U
        csBundle(2 * i + 1).lsrc(1) := src2 + i.U
        csBundle(2 * i + 1).lsrc(2) := dest + (2 * i + 1).U
        csBundle(2 * i + 1).ldest := dest + (2 * i + 1).U
        csBundle(2 * i + 1).uopIdx := (2 * i + 1).U
      }
    }
    is(UopSplitType.VEC_EXT4) {
      for (i <- 0 until MAX_VLMUL / 4) {
        csBundle(4 * i).lsrc(1) := src2 + i.U
        csBundle(4 * i).lsrc(2) := dest + (4 * i).U
        csBundle(4 * i).ldest := dest + (4 * i).U
        csBundle(4 * i).uopIdx := (4 * i).U
        csBundle(4 * i + 1).lsrc(1) := src2 + i.U
        csBundle(4 * i + 1).lsrc(2) := dest + (4 * i + 1).U
        csBundle(4 * i + 1).ldest := dest + (4 * i + 1).U
        csBundle(4 * i + 1).uopIdx := (4 * i + 1).U
        csBundle(4 * i + 2).lsrc(1) := src2 + i.U

            csBundle((i * len + j)*2+1).lsrc(0) := src1 + (i*2+1).U
            csBundle((i * len + j)*2+1).lsrc(1) := src2 + j.U
            csBundle((i * len + j)*2+1).lsrc(2) := vd_old1
            csBundle((i * len + j)*2+1).ldest := vd1
            csBundle((i * len + j)*2+1).uopIdx := ((i * len + j)*2+1).U
          }
      }
      def genCsBundle_VEC_RGATHEREI16(len:Int): Unit ={
        for (i <- 0 until len)
          for (j <- 0 until len) {
            val vd_old = if(j==0) (dest + i.U) else (VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL + j-1).U
            val vd = if(j==len-1) (dest + i.U) else (VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL + j).U
            csBundle(i * len + j).lsrc(0) := src1 + i.U
            csBundle(i * len + j).lsrc(1) := src2 + j.U
            csBundle(i * len + j).lsrc(2) := vd_old
            csBundle(i * len + j).ldest := vd
            csBundle(i * len + j).uopIdx := (i * len + j).U
          }
      }
      def genCsBundle_VEC_RGATHEREI16_SEW32(len:Int): Unit ={
        for (i <- 0 until len)
          for (j <- 0 until len) {
            val vd_old = if(j==0) (dest + i.U) else (VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL + j-1).U
            val vd = if(j==len-1) (dest + i.U) else (VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL + j).U
            csBundle(i * len + j).lsrc(0) := src1 + (i / 2).U
            csBundle(i * len + j).lsrc(1) := src2 + j.U
            csBundle(i * len + j).lsrc(2) := vd_old
            csBundle(i * len + j).ldest := vd
            csBundle(i * len + j).uopIdx := (i * len + j).U
          }
      }
      def genCsBundle_VEC_RGATHEREI16_SEW64(len:Int): Unit ={
        for (i <- 0 until len)
          for (j <- 0 until len) {
            val vd_old = if(j==0) (dest + i.U) else (VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL + j-1).U
            val vd = if(j==len-1) (dest + i.U) else (VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL + j).U
            csBundle(i * len + j).lsrc(0) := src1 + (i / 4).U
            csBundle(i * len + j).lsrc(1) := src2 + j.U
            csBundle(i * len + j).lsrc(2) := vd_old
            csBundle(i * len + j).ldest := vd
            csBundle(i * len + j).uopIdx := (i * len + j).U
          }
      }
      when(!vsewReg.orR){
        genCsBundle_VEC_RGATHEREI16_SEW8(1)
      }.elsewhen(vsewReg === VSew.e32){
        genCsBundle_VEC_RGATHEREI16_SEW32(1)
      }.elsewhen(vsewReg === VSew.e64){
        genCsBundle_VEC_RGATHEREI16_SEW64(1)
      }.otherwise{
        genCsBundle_VEC_RGATHEREI16(1)
      }
      switch(vlmulReg) {
        is("b001".U) {
          when(!vsewReg.orR) {
            genCsBundle_VEC_RGATHEREI16_SEW8(2)
          }.elsewhen(vsewReg === VSew.e32){
            genCsBundle_VEC_RGATHEREI16_SEW32(2)
          }.elsewhen(vsewReg === VSew.e64){
            genCsBundle_VEC_RGATHEREI16_SEW64(2)
          }.otherwise{
            genCsBundle_VEC_RGATHEREI16(2)
          }
        }
        is("b010".U) {
          when(!vsewReg.orR) {
            genCsBundle_VEC_RGATHEREI16_SEW8(4)
          }.elsewhen(vsewReg === VSew.e32){
            genCsBundle_VEC_RGATHEREI16_SEW32(4)
          }.elsewhen(vsewReg === VSew.e64){
            genCsBundle_VEC_RGATHEREI16_SEW64(4)
          }.otherwise{
            genCsBundle_VEC_RGATHEREI16(4)
          }
        }
        is("b011".U) {
          when(vsewReg === VSew.e32){
            genCsBundle_VEC_RGATHEREI16_SEW32(8)
          }.elsewhen(vsewReg === VSew.e64){
            genCsBundle_VEC_RGATHEREI16_SEW64(8)
          }.otherwise{
            genCsBundle_VEC_RGATHEREI16(8)
          }
        }
      }
    }
    is(UopSplitType.VEC_COMPRESS) {
      def genCsBundle_VEC_COMPRESS(len:Int): Unit = {
        for (i <- 0 until len) {
          val jlen = if (i == len-1) i+1 else i+2
          for (j <- 0 until jlen) {
            val vd_old = if(i==j) (dest + i.U) else (VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL + j + 1).U
            val vd = if(i==len-1) (dest + j.U) else {
              if (j == i+1) VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL.U  else (VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL + j + 1).U
            }
            csBundle(i*(i+3)/2 + j).vecWen := true.B
            csBundle(i*(i+3)/2 + j).v0Wen := false.B
            val src13Type = if (j == i+1) DontCare else SrcType.vp
            csBundle(i*(i+3)/2 + j).srcType(0) := src13Type
            csBundle(i*(i+3)/2 + j).srcType(1) := SrcType.vp
            csBundle(i*(i+3)/2 + j).srcType(2) := src13Type
            if (i == 0) {
              csBundle(i*(i+3)/2 + j).lsrc(0) := src1
            } else {
              csBundle(i*(i+3)/2 + j).lsrc(0) := VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL.U
            }
            csBundle(i*(i+3)/2 + j).lsrc(1) := src2 + i.U
            csBundle(i*(i+3)/2 + j).lsrc(2) := vd_old
            csBundle(i*(i+3)/2 + j).ldest := vd
            csBundle(i*(i+3)/2 + j).uopIdx := (i*(i+3)/2 + j).U
          }
        }
      }
      switch(vlmulReg) {
        is("b001".U ){
          genCsBundle_VEC_COMPRESS(2)
        }
        is("b010".U ){
          genCsBundle_VEC_COMPRESS(4)
        }
        is("b011".U ){
          genCsBundle_VEC_COMPRESS(8)
        }
      }
    }
    is(UopSplitType.VEC_MVNR) {
      for (i <- 0 until MAX_VLMUL) {
        csBundle(i).lsrc(0) := src1 + i.U
        csBundle(i).lsrc(1) := src2 + i.U
        csBundle(i).lsrc(2) := dest + i.U
        csBundle(i).ldest := dest + i.U
        csBundle(i).uopIdx := i.U
      }
    }
    is(UopSplitType.VEC_US_LDST) {
      /*
      FMV.D.X
       */
      csBundle(0).srcType(0) := SrcType.reg
      csBundle(0).srcType(1) := SrcType.imm
      csBundle(0).lsrc(1) := 0.U
      csBundle(0).ldest := VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL.U
      csBundle(0).fuType := FuType.i2v.U
      csBundle(0).fuOpType := Cat(IF2VectorType.i2Vec(2, 0), e64)
      csBundle(0).rfWen := false.B
      csBundle(0).fpWen := false.B
      csBundle(0).vecWen := true.B
      csBundle(0).vlsInstr := true.B
      //LMUL
      for (i <- 0 until MAX_VLMUL) {
        csBundle(i + 1).srcType(0) := SrcType.vp
        csBundle(i + 1).lsrc(0) := VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL.U
        csBundle(i + 1).lsrc(2) := dest + i.U // old vd
        csBundle(i + 1).ldest := dest + i.U
        csBundle(i + 1).uopIdx := i.U
        csBundle(i + 1).vlsInstr := true.B
      }
      csBundle.head.waitForward := isUsSegment
      csBundle(numOfUop - 1.U).blockBackward := isUsSegment
    }
    is(UopSplitType.VEC_US_FF_LD) {
      csBundle(0).srcType(0) := SrcType.reg
      csBundle(0).srcType(1) := SrcType.imm
      csBundle(0).lsrc(1) := 0.U
      csBundle(0).ldest := VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL.U
      csBundle(0).fuType := FuType.i2v.U
      csBundle(0).fuOpType := Cat(IF2VectorType.i2Vec(2, 0), e64)
      csBundle(0).rfWen := false.B
      csBundle(0).fpWen := false.B
      csBundle(0).vecWen := true.B
      csBundle(0).vlsInstr := true.B
      //LMUL
      for (i <- 0 until MAX_VLMUL) {
        csBundle(i + 1).srcType(0) := SrcType.vp
        csBundle(i + 1).lsrc(0) := VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL.U
        csBundle(i + 1).lsrc(2) := dest + i.U // old vd
        csBundle(i + 1).ldest := dest + i.U
        csBundle(i + 1).uopIdx := i.U
        csBundle(i + 1).vlsInstr := true.B
      }

      csBundle(numOfUop - 1.U).blockBackward := isUsSegment

      csBundle(numOfUop - 1.U).srcType(0) := SrcType.no
      csBundle(numOfUop - 1.U).srcType(1) := SrcType.no
      csBundle(numOfUop - 1.U).srcType(2) := SrcType.no
      csBundle(numOfUop - 1.U).srcType(3) := SrcType.no
      csBundle(numOfUop - 1.U).srcType(4) := SrcType.vp
      csBundle(numOfUop - 1.U).lsrc(4) := Vl_IDX.U
      // vtype
      csBundle(numOfUop - 1.U).vecWen := false.B
      csBundle(numOfUop - 1.U).vlWen := true.B

      FMV.D.X

      csBundle(0).fpWen := false.B
      csBundle(0).vecWen := true.B
      csBundle(0).vlsInstr := true.B

      csBundle(1).srcType(1) := SrcType.imm
      csBundle(1).lsrc(0) := latchedInst.lsrc(1)
      csBundle(1).lsrc(1) := 0.U
      csBundle(1).ldest := (VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL + 1).U
      csBundle(1).fuType := FuType.i2v.U
      csBundle(1).fuOpType := Cat(IF2VectorType.i2Vec(2, 0), e64)
      csBundle(1).rfWen := false.B
      csBundle(1).fpWen := false.B
      csBundle(1).vecWen := true.B
      csBundle(1).vlsInstr := true.B

      for (i <- 0 until MAX_VLMUL) {
        csBundle(i + 2).srcType(0) := SrcType.vp
        csBundle(i + 2).srcType(1) := SrcType.vp
        csBundle(i + 2).lsrc(0) := VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL.U
        csBundle(i + 2).lsrc(1) := (VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL + 1).U
        csBundle(i + 2).lsrc(2) := dest + i.U // old vd
        csBundle(i + 2).ldest := dest + i.U
        csBundle(i + 2).uopIdx := i.U
        csBundle(i + 2).vlsInstr := true.B
      }
      csBundle.head.waitForward := isSdSegment
      csBundle(numOfUop - 1.U).blockBackward := isSdSegment
    }
    is(UopSplitType.VEC_I_LDST) {
      def genCsBundle_SEGMENT_INDEXED_LOADSTORE(lmul:Int, nf:Int): Unit ={
        for (i <- 0 until MAX_VLMUL) {
          val vecWen = if (i < lmul * nf) true.B else false.B
          val src2Type = if (i < lmul * nf) SrcType.vp else SrcType.no
          csBundle(i + 1).srcType(0) := SrcType.vp
          csBundle(i + 1).lsrc(0) := VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL.U
          csBundle(i + 1).srcType(1) := SrcType.no
          csBundle(i + 1).lsrc(1) := src2 + i.U
          csBundle(i + 1).srcType(2) := src2Type
          csBundle(i + 1).lsrc(2) := dest + i.U
          csBundle(i + 1).ldest := dest + i.U
          csBundle(i + 1).rfWen := false.B
          csBundle(i + 1).fpWen := false.B
          csBundle(i + 1).vecWen := vecWen
          csBundle(i + 1).uopIdx := i.U
          csBundle(i + 1).vlsInstr := true.B
        }
      }
      def genCsBundle_SEGMENT_INDEXED_LOADSTORE_SRC1(emul:Int): Unit ={
        for (i <- 0 until MAX_VLMUL) {
          val src1Type = if (i < emul) SrcType.vp else SrcType.no
          csBundle(i + 1).srcType(1) := src1Type
          csBundle(i + 1).lsrc(1) := src2 + i.U
        }
      }

      val vlmul = vlmulReg
      val vsew = Cat(0.U(1.W), vsewReg)
      val veew = Cat(0.U(1.W), width)
      val vemul: UInt = veew.asUInt + 1.U + vlmul.asUInt + ~vsew.asUInt
      val simple_lmul = MuxLookup(vlmul, 0.U(2.W))(Seq(
        "b001".U -> 1.U,
        "b010".U -> 2.U,
        "b011".U -> 3.U
      ))
      val simple_emul = MuxLookup(vemul, 0.U(2.W))(Seq(
        "b001".U -> 1.U,
        "b010".U -> 2.U,
        "b011".U -> 3.U
      ))
      csBundle(0).srcType(0) := SrcType.reg
      csBundle(0).srcType(1) := SrcType.imm
      csBundle(0).lsrc(1) := 0.U
      csBundle(0).ldest := VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL.U
      csBundle(0).fuType := FuType.i2v.U
      csBundle(0).fuOpType := Cat(IF2VectorType.i2Vec(2, 0), e64)
      csBundle(0).rfWen := false.B
      csBundle(0).fpWen := false.B
      csBundle(0).vecWen := true.B
      csBundle(0).vlsInstr := true.B

      //LMUL
      when(nf === 0.U) {
        for (i <- 0 until MAX_VLMUL) {
          indexedLSRegOffset(i).src := Cat(simple_emul, simple_lmul)
          val offsetVs2 = indexedLSRegOffset(i).outOffsetVs2
          val offsetVd = indexedLSRegOffset(i).outOffsetVd
          csBundle(i + 1).srcType(0) := SrcType.vp
          csBundle(i + 1).lsrc(0) := VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL.U
          csBundle(i + 1).lsrc(1) := Mux1H(UIntToOH(offsetVs2, MAX_VLMUL), (0 until MAX_VLMUL).map(j => src2 + j.U))
          csBundle(i + 1).srcType(2) := SrcType.vp
          // lsrc2 is old vd
          csBundle(i + 1).lsrc(2) := Mux1H(UIntToOH(offsetVd, MAX_VLMUL), (0 until MAX_VLMUL).map(j => dest + j.U))
          csBundle(i + 1).ldest := Mux1H(UIntToOH(offsetVd, MAX_VLMUL), (0 until MAX_VLMUL).map(j => dest + j.U))
          csBundle(i + 1).uopIdx := i.U
          csBundle(i + 1).vlsInstr := true.B
        }
      }.otherwise{
        // nf > 1, is segment indexed load/store
        // gen src0, vd
        switch(simple_lmul) {
          is(0.U) {
            switch(nf) {
              is(1.U) {
                genCsBundle_SEGMENT_INDEXED_LOADSTORE(1, 2)
              }
              is(2.U) {
                genCsBundle_SEGMENT_INDEXED_LOADSTORE(1, 3)
              }
              is(3.U) {
                genCsBundle_SEGMENT_INDEXED_LOADSTORE(1, 4)
              }
              is(4.U) {
                genCsBundle_SEGMENT_INDEXED_LOADSTORE(1, 5)
              }
              is(5.U) {
                genCsBundle_SEGMENT_INDEXED_LOADSTORE(1, 6)
              }
              is(6.U) {
                genCsBundle_SEGMENT_INDEXED_LOADSTORE(1, 7)
              }
              is(7.U) {
                genCsBundle_SEGMENT_INDEXED_LOADSTORE(1, 8)
              }
            }
          }
          is(1.U) {
            switch(nf) {
              is(1.U) {
                genCsBundle_SEGMENT_INDEXED_LOADSTORE(2, 2)
              }
              is(2.U) {
                genCsBundle_SEGMENT_INDEXED_LOADSTORE(2, 3)
              }
              is(3.U) {
                genCsBundle_SEGMENT_INDEXED_LOADSTORE(2, 4)
              }
            }
          }
          is(2.U) {
            switch(nf) {
              is(1.U) {
                genCsBundle_SEGMENT_INDEXED_LOADSTORE(4, 2)
              }
            }
          }
        }

        // gen src1
        switch(simple_emul) {
          is(0.U) {
            genCsBundle_SEGMENT_INDEXED_LOADSTORE_SRC1(1)
          }
          is(1.U) {
            genCsBundle_SEGMENT_INDEXED_LOADSTORE_SRC1(2)
          }
          is(2.U) {
            genCsBundle_SEGMENT_INDEXED_LOADSTORE_SRC1(4)
          }
          is(3.U) {
            genCsBundle_SEGMENT_INDEXED_LOADSTORE_SRC1(8)
          }
        }

            csBundle(i + 1).vecWen := false.B
          }
        }
      }
      csBundle.head.waitForward := isIxSegment
      csBundle(numOfUop - 1.U).blockBackward := isIxSegment
    }
  }

  val countNext = WireInit(count)

  switch(state) {
    is(s_idle) {
      when (inValid) {
        stateNext := s_active
        uopResNext := inUopInfo.numOfUop
        countNext := 0.U
      }
    }
    is(s_active) {
      when (thisAllOut) {
        when (inValid) {
          stateNext := s_active
          uopResNext := inUopInfo.numOfUop
        }.otherwise {
          stateNext := s_idle
          uopResNext := 0.U
        }
        countNext := 0.U
      }.otherwise {
        stateNext := s_active
        uopResNext := uopRes - readyCounter
        countNext := count + outReadys.head.asUInt
      }
    }
  }

  state := Mux(io.redirect, s_idle, stateNext)
  uopRes := Mux(io.redirect, 0.U, uopResNext)
  count := Mux(io.redirect, 0.U, countNext)

  val complexNum = Mux(uopRes > readyCounter, readyCounter, uopRes)

  fixedDecodedInst := csBundle

  // when vstart is not zero, the last uop will modify vstart to zero
  // therefore, blockback and flush pipe
  fixedDecodedInst(numOfUop - 1.U).flushPipe := (vstartReg =/= 0.U) || latchedInst.flushPipe
  val uopsSeq = (0 until RenameWidth).map(i => VecInit(fixedDecodedInst.zipWithIndex.filter(_._2 % RenameWidth == i).map(_._1)))

  /** Generate output insts and valid signals */
  for(i <- 0 until RenameWidth) {
    outValids(i) := complexNum > i.U
    outDecodedInsts(i) := uopsSeq(i)(count)
  }

  /** Generate number of valid output insts */
  outComplexNum := Mux(state === s_active, complexNum, 0.U)
  inReady := state === s_idle || state === s_active && thisAllOut


  XSError(inValid && inUopInfo.numOfUop === 0.U,
    p"uop number ${inUopInfo.numOfUop} is illegal, cannot be zero")

import xiangshan.backend.decode.isa.bitfield.XSInstBitFields
import xiangshan.backend.fu.vector.Bundles.{VSew, VType, VLmul, Vl}
import yunsuan.VpermType
import chisel3.util.experimental.decode.{QMCMinimizer, TruthTable, decoder}

class indexedLSUopTable(uopIdx:Int) extends Module {
  val src = IO(Input(UInt(4.W)))
  val outOffsetVs2 = IO(Output(UInt(3.W)))
  val outOffsetVd = IO(Output(UInt(3.W)))
  def genCsBundle_VEC_INDEXED_LDST(lmul:Int, emul:Int, uopIdx:Int): (Int, Int) ={
    // only consider non segment indexed load/store
    if (lmul < emul) {    // lmul < emul, uop num is depend on emul * nf
      var offset = 1 << (emul - lmul)
      for (i <- 0 until (1 << emul)) {
        if (uopIdx == i) {
          return (i, i / offset)
        }
      }
    } else {              // lmul > emul, uop num is depend on lmul * nf
      var offset = 1 << (lmul - emul)
      for (i <- 0 until (1 << lmul)) {
        if (uopIdx == i) {
          return (i / offset, i)
        }
      }
    }
    return (0, 0)
  }
  // strided load/store
  var combVemulNf : Seq[(Int, Int, Int, Int)] = Seq()
  for (emul <- 0 until 4) {
    for (lmul <- 0 until 4) {
      var offset = genCsBundle_VEC_INDEXED_LDST(lmul, emul, uopIdx)
      var offsetVs2 = offset._1
      var offsetVd = offset._2
      combVemulNf :+= (emul, lmul, offsetVs2, offsetVd)
    }
  }
  val out = decoder(QMCMinimizer, src, TruthTable(combVemulNf.map {
    case (emul, lmul, offsetVs2, offsetVd) =>
      (BitPat((emul << 2 | lmul).U(4.W)), BitPat((offsetVs2 << 3 | offsetVd).U(6.W)))
  }, BitPat.N(6)))
  outOffsetVs2 := out(5, 3)
  outOffsetVd := out(2, 0)
}

trait VectorConstants {
  val MAX_VLMUL = 8
  val VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL = 32 // 32~46  ->  15
  val VECTOR_COMPRESS = 1 // in v0 regfile
  val MAX_INDEXED_LS_UOPNUM = 64
}

class DecodeUnitCompInput(implicit p: Parameters) extends XSBundle {
  val simpleDecodedInst = new DecodedInst
  val uopInfo = new UopInfo
}

class DecodeUnitCompOutput(implicit p: Parameters) extends XSBundle {
  val complexDecodedInsts = Vec(RenameWidth, DecoupledIO(new DecodedInst))
}

class DecodeUnitCompIO(implicit p: Parameters) extends XSBundle {
  val redirect = Input(Bool())
  val csrCtrl = Input(new CustomCSRCtrlIO)
  val vtypeBypass = Input(new VType)
  // When the first inst in decode vector is complex inst, pass it in
  val in = Flipped(DecoupledIO(new DecodeUnitCompInput))
  val out = new DecodeUnitCompOutput
  val complexNum = Output(UInt(3.W))
}

/**
 * @author zly
 */
class DecodeUnitComp()(implicit p : Parameters) extends XSModule with DecodeUnitConstants with VectorConstants {
  val io = IO(new DecodeUnitCompIO)

  // alias
  private val inReady = io.in.ready
  private val inValid = io.in.valid
  private val inDecodedInst = WireInit(io.in.bits.simpleDecodedInst)
  private val inInstFields = io.in.bits.simpleDecodedInst.instr.asTypeOf(new XSInstBitFields)
  private val inUopInfo = io.in.bits.uopInfo
  private val outValids = io.out.complexDecodedInsts.map(_.valid)
  private val outReadys = io.out.complexDecodedInsts.map(_.ready)
  private val outDecodedInsts = io.out.complexDecodedInsts.map(_.bits)
  private val outComplexNum = io.complexNum

  val maxUopSize = MaxUopSize
  when (io.in.fire && io.in.bits.simpleDecodedInst.isVset) {
    when(inInstFields.RD === 0.U && inInstFields.RS1 === 0.U) {
      inDecodedInst.fuOpType := VSETOpType.keepVl(io.in.bits.simpleDecodedInst.fuOpType)
    }.elsewhen(inInstFields.RS1 === 0.U) {
      inDecodedInst.fuOpType := VSETOpType.setVlmax(io.in.bits.simpleDecodedInst.fuOpType)
    }
  }

  val latchedInst = RegEnable(inDecodedInst, inValid && inReady)
  val latchedUopInfo = RegEnable(inUopInfo, inValid && inReady)
  //input bits
  private val instFields: XSInstBitFields = latchedInst.instr.asTypeOf(new XSInstBitFields)

  val src1 = Cat(0.U(1.W), instFields.RS1)
  val src2 = Cat(0.U(1.W), instFields.RS2)
  val dest = Cat(0.U(1.W), instFields.RD)

  val nf    = instFields.NF
  val width = instFields.WIDTH(1, 0)

  //output of DecodeUnit
  val numOfUop = Wire(UInt(log2Up(maxUopSize).W))
  val numOfWB = Wire(UInt(log2Up(maxUopSize).W))
  val lmul = Wire(UInt(4.W))
  val isVsetSimple = Wire(Bool())

  val indexedLSRegOffset = Seq.tabulate(MAX_VLMUL)(i => Module(new indexedLSUopTable(i)))
  indexedLSRegOffset.map(_.src := 0.U)

  //pre decode
  lmul := latchedUopInfo.lmul
  isVsetSimple := latchedInst.isVset
  val vlmulReg = latchedInst.vpu.vlmul
  val vsewReg = latchedInst.vpu.vsew
  val vstartReg = latchedInst.vpu.vstart

  //Type of uop Div
  val typeOfSplit = latchedInst.uopSplitType
  val src1Type = latchedInst.srcType(0)
  val src1IsImm = src1Type === SrcType.imm
  val src1IsFp = src1Type === SrcType.fp

  val isVstore = FuType.isVStore(latchedInst.fuType)

  // exception generator
  val vecException = Module(new VecExceptionGen)
  vecException.io.inst := latchedInst.instr
  vecException.io.decodedInst := latchedInst
  vecException.io.vtype := latchedInst.vpu.vtype
  vecException.io.vstart := latchedInst.vpu.vstart
  val illegalInst = vecException.io.illegalInst

  numOfUop := latchedUopInfo.numOfUop
  numOfWB := latchedUopInfo.numOfWB

  //uops dispatch
  val s_idle :: s_active :: Nil = Enum(2)
  val state = RegInit(s_idle)
  val stateNext = WireDefault(state)
  val numDecodedUop = RegInit(0.U(log2Up(maxUopSize).W))
  val uopRes = RegInit(0.U(log2Up(maxUopSize).W))
  val uopResNext = WireInit(uopRes)
  val e64 = 3.U(2.W)
  val isUsSegment = instFields.MOP === 0.U && ((nf =/= 0.U && instFields.LUMOP === 0.U) || instFields.LUMOP === "b10000".U)
  val isIxSegment = instFields.MOP(0) === 1.U && nf =/= 0.U
  val isSdSegment = instFields.MOP === "b10".U && nf =/= 0.U

  //uop div up to maxUopSize
  val csBundle = Wire(Vec(maxUopSize, new DecodedInst))
  val fixedDecodedInst = Wire(Vec(maxUopSize, new DecodedInst))

  csBundle.foreach { case dst =>
    dst := latchedInst
    dst.numUops := latchedUopInfo.numOfUop
    dst.numWB := latchedUopInfo.numOfWB
    dst.exceptionVec(ExceptionNO.EX_II) := latchedInst.exceptionVec(ExceptionNO.EX_II) || illegalInst
    dst.firstUop := false.B
    dst.lastUop := false.B
    dst.vlsInstr := false.B
  }

  csBundle(0).firstUop := true.B
  csBundle(numOfUop - 1.U).lastUop := true.B

  // when vstart is not zero, the last uop will modify vstart to zero
  // therefore, blockback and flush pipe
  csBundle(numOfUop - 1.U).blockBackward := vstartReg =/= 0.U
  csBundle(0.U).flushPipe := vstartReg =/= 0.U

  switch(typeOfSplit) {
    is(UopSplitType.AMO_CAS_W) {
      csBundle(0).uopIdx := 0.U
      csBundle(0).fuOpType := Cat(1.U(3.W), LSUOpType.amocas_w)
      csBundle(0).lsrc(0) := 0.U
      csBundle(0).lsrc(1) := src2
      csBundle(0).rfWen := false.B
      csBundle(0).waitForward := true.B
      csBundle(0).blockBackward := false.B

      csBundle(1).uopIdx := 1.U
      csBundle(1).fuOpType := Cat(0.U(3.W), LSUOpType.amocas_w)
      csBundle(1).lsrc(0) := src1
      csBundle(1).lsrc(1) := dest
      csBundle(1).waitForward := false.B
      csBundle(1).blockBackward := true.B
    }
    is(UopSplitType.AMO_CAS_D) {
      csBundle(0).uopIdx := 0.U
      csBundle(0).fuOpType := Cat(1.U(3.W), LSUOpType.amocas_d)
      csBundle(0).lsrc(0) := 0.U
      csBundle(0).lsrc(1) := src2
      csBundle(0).rfWen := false.B
      csBundle(0).waitForward := true.B
      csBundle(0).blockBackward := false.B

      csBundle(1).uopIdx := 1.U
      csBundle(1).fuOpType := Cat(0.U(3.W), LSUOpType.amocas_d)
      csBundle(1).lsrc(0) := src1
      csBundle(1).lsrc(1) := dest
      csBundle(1).waitForward := false.B
      csBundle(1).blockBackward := true.B
    }
    is(UopSplitType.AMO_CAS_Q) {
      csBundle(0).uopIdx := 0.U
      csBundle(0).fuOpType := Cat(1.U(3.W), LSUOpType.amocas_q)
      csBundle(0).lsrc(0) := 0.U
      csBundle(0).lsrc(1) := src2
      csBundle(0).rfWen := false.B
      csBundle(0).waitForward := true.B
      csBundle(0).blockBackward := false.B

      csBundle(1).uopIdx := 1.U
      csBundle(1).fuOpType := Cat(0.U(3.W), LSUOpType.amocas_q)
      csBundle(1).lsrc(0) := src1
      csBundle(1).lsrc(1) := dest
      csBundle(1).waitForward := false.B
      csBundle(1).blockBackward := false.B

      csBundle(2).uopIdx := 2.U
      csBundle(2).fuOpType := Cat(3.U(3.W), LSUOpType.amocas_q)
      csBundle(2).lsrc(0) := 0.U
      csBundle(2).lsrc(1) := Mux(src2 === 0.U, 0.U, src2 + 1.U)
      csBundle(2).rfWen := false.B
      csBundle(2).waitForward := false.B
      csBundle(2).blockBackward := false.B

      csBundle(3).uopIdx := 3.U
      csBundle(3).fuOpType := Cat(2.U(3.W), LSUOpType.amocas_q)
      csBundle(3).lsrc(0) := 0.U
      csBundle(3).lsrc(1) := Mux(dest === 0.U, 0.U, dest + 1.U)
      csBundle(3).ldest := Mux(dest === 0.U, 0.U, dest + 1.U)
      csBundle(3).waitForward := false.B
      csBundle(3).blockBackward := true.B
    }
    is(UopSplitType.VSET) {
      // In simple decoder, rfWen and vecWen are not set
      when(isVsetSimple) {
        // Default
        // uop0 set rd, never flushPipe
        csBundle(0).fuType := FuType.vsetiwi.U
        csBundle(0).flushPipe := Mux(VSETOpType.isVsetvl(latchedInst.fuOpType), true.B, vstartReg =/= 0.U)
        csBundle(0).blockBackward := false.B
        csBundle(0).rfWen := true.B
        // uop1 set vl, vsetvl will flushPipe
        csBundle(1).ldest := Vl_IDX.U
        csBundle(1).vecWen := false.B
        csBundle(1).vlWen := true.B
        csBundle(1).flushPipe := false.B
        csBundle(1).blockBackward := Mux(VSETOpType.isVsetvl(latchedInst.fuOpType), true.B, vstartReg =/= 0.U)
        when(VSETOpType.isVsetvli(latchedInst.fuOpType) && dest === 0.U && src1 === 0.U) {
          // write nothing, uop0 is a nop instruction
          csBundle(0).rfWen := false.B
          csBundle(0).fpWen := false.B
          csBundle(0).vecWen := false.B
          csBundle(0).vlWen := false.B
          csBundle(1).fuType := FuType.vsetfwf.U
          csBundle(1).srcType(0) := SrcType.no
          csBundle(1).srcType(2) := SrcType.no
          csBundle(1).srcType(3) := SrcType.no
          csBundle(1).srcType(4) := SrcType.vp
          csBundle(1).lsrc(4) := Vl_IDX.U
        }.elsewhen(VSETOpType.isVsetvl(latchedInst.fuOpType) && dest === 0.U && src1 === 0.U) {
          // uop0: mv vtype gpr to vector region
          csBundle(0).srcType(0) := SrcType.xp
          csBundle(0).srcType(1) := SrcType.no
          csBundle(0).lsrc(0) := src2
          csBundle(0).lsrc(1) := 0.U
          csBundle(0).ldest := VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL.U
          csBundle(0).fuType := FuType.i2v.U
          csBundle(0).fuOpType := Cat(IF2VectorType.i2Vec(2, 0), e64)
          csBundle(0).rfWen := false.B
          csBundle(0).fpWen := false.B
          csBundle(0).vecWen := true.B
          csBundle(0).vlWen := false.B
          // uop1: uvsetvcfg_vv
          csBundle(1).fuType := FuType.vsetfwf.U
          // vl
          csBundle(1).srcType(0) := SrcType.no
          csBundle(1).srcType(2) := SrcType.no
          csBundle(1).srcType(3) := SrcType.no
          csBundle(1).srcType(4) := SrcType.vp
          csBundle(1).lsrc(4) := Vl_IDX.U
          // vtype
          csBundle(1).srcType(1) := SrcType.vp
          csBundle(1).lsrc(1) := VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL.U
          csBundle(1).vecWen := false.B
          csBundle(1).vlWen := true.B
          csBundle(1).ldest := Vl_IDX.U
        }.elsewhen(dest === 0.U) {
          // write nothing, uop0 is a nop instruction
          csBundle(0).rfWen := false.B
          csBundle(0).fpWen := false.B
          csBundle(0).vecWen := false.B
          csBundle(0).vlWen := false.B
        }.elsewhen(VSETOpType.isVsetvl(latchedInst.fuOpType)) {
          // because vsetvl may modified src2 when src2 == rd,
          // we need to modify vd in second uop to avoid dependency
          // uop0 set vl
          csBundle(0).fuType := FuType.vsetiwf.U
          csBundle(0).ldest := Vl_IDX.U
          csBundle(0).rfWen := false.B
          csBundle(0).vlWen := true.B
          // uop1 set rd
          csBundle(1).fuType := FuType.vsetiwi.U
          csBundle(1).ldest := dest
          csBundle(1).rfWen := true.B
          csBundle(1).vlWen := false.B
        }
        // use bypass vtype from vtypeGen
        csBundle(0).vpu.connectVType(io.vtypeBypass)
        csBundle(1).vpu.connectVType(io.vtypeBypass)
      }
    }
    is(UopSplitType.VEC_VDOT) {
      csBundle(0).lsrc(0) := src1
      csBundle(0).lsrc(1) := src2
      csBundle(0).lsrc(2) := dest
      // 点积完整覆盖目的寄存器，算术运算及尾部/掩码合并均不读取旧 vd。
      // 在 DecodeStage 识别辅助 v0 源之前清除无用的第三源类型；
      // vs1/vs2 的真实重叠依赖（包括 v0）仍按普通向量源处理。
      csBundle(0).srcType(2) := SrcType.no
      csBundle(0).ldest := dest
      csBundle(0).uopIdx := 0.U
    }
    is(UopSplitType.VEC_VVV) {
      for (i <- 0 until MAX_VLMUL) {
        csBundle(i).lsrc(0) := src1 + i.U
        csBundle(i).lsrc(1) := src2 + i.U
        csBundle(i).lsrc(2) := dest + i.U
        csBundle(i).ldest := dest + i.U
        csBundle(i).uopIdx := i.U
      }
    }
    is(UopSplitType.VEC_VFV) {
      /*
      f to vector move
       */
      csBundle(0).srcType(0) := SrcType.fp
      csBundle(0).srcType(1) := SrcType.imm
      csBundle(0).srcType(2) := SrcType.imm
      csBundle(0).lsrc(1) := 0.U
      csBundle(0).ldest := VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL.U
      csBundle(0).fuType := FuType.f2v.U
      csBundle(0).fuOpType := Cat(IF2VectorType.fDup2Vec(2, 0), vsewReg)
      csBundle(0).vecWen := true.B
      csBundle(0).vpu.isReverse := false.B
      /*
      LMUL
       */
      for (i <- 0 until MAX_VLMUL) {
        csBundle(i + 1).srcType(0) := SrcType.vp
        csBundle(i + 1).lsrc(0) := VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL.U
        csBundle(i + 1).lsrc(1) := src2 + i.U
        csBundle(i + 1).lsrc(2) := dest + i.U
        csBundle(i + 1).ldest := dest + i.U
        csBundle(i + 1).uopIdx := i.U
      }
    }
    is(UopSplitType.VEC_EXT2) {
      for (i <- 0 until MAX_VLMUL / 2) {
        csBundle(2 * i).lsrc(1) := src2 + i.U
        csBundle(2 * i).lsrc(2) := dest + (2 * i).U
        csBundle(2 * i).ldest := dest + (2 * i).U
        csBundle(2 * i).uopIdx := (2 * i).U
        csBundle(2 * i + 1).lsrc(1) := src2 + i.U
        csBundle(2 * i + 1).lsrc(2) := dest + (2 * i + 1).U
        csBundle(2 * i + 1).ldest := dest + (2 * i + 1).U
        csBundle(2 * i + 1).uopIdx := (2 * i + 1).U
      }
    }
    is(UopSplitType.VEC_EXT4) {
      for (i <- 0 until MAX_VLMUL / 4) {
        csBundle(4 * i).lsrc(1) := src2 + i.U
        csBundle(4 * i).lsrc(2) := dest + (4 * i).U
        csBundle(4 * i).ldest := dest + (4 * i).U
        csBundle(4 * i).uopIdx := (4 * i).U
        csBundle(4 * i + 1).lsrc(1) := src2 + i.U
        csBundle(4 * i + 1).lsrc(2) := dest + (4 * i + 1).U
        csBundle(4 * i + 1).ldest := dest + (4 * i + 1).U
        csBundle(4 * i + 1).uopIdx := (4 * i + 1).U
        csBundle(4 * i + 2).lsrc(1) := src2 + i.U
        csBundle(4 * i + 2).lsrc(2) := dest + (4 * i + 2).U
        csBundle(4 * i + 2).ldest := dest + (4 * i + 2).U
        csBundle(4 * i + 2).uopIdx := (4 * i + 2).U
        csBundle(4 * i + 3).lsrc(1) := src2 + i.U
        csBundle(4 * i + 3).lsrc(2) := dest + (4 * i + 3).U
        csBundle(4 * i + 3).ldest := dest + (4 * i + 3).U
        csBundle(4 * i + 3).uopIdx := (4 * i + 3).U
      }
    }
    is(UopSplitType.VEC_EXT8) {
      for (i <- 0 until MAX_VLMUL) {
        csBundle(i).lsrc(1) := src2
        csBundle(i).lsrc(2) := dest + i.U
        csBundle(i).ldest := dest + i.U
        csBundle(i).uopIdx := i.U
      }
    }
    is(UopSplitType.VEC_0XV) {
      /*
      i/f to vector move
       */
      csBundle(0).srcType(0) := Mux(src1IsFp, SrcType.fp, SrcType.reg)
      csBundle(0).srcType(1) := SrcType.imm
      csBundle(0).srcType(2) := SrcType.imm
      csBundle(0).lsrc(1) := 0.U
      csBundle(0).ldest := VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL.U
      csBundle(0).fuType := Mux(src1IsFp, FuType.f2v.U, FuType.i2v.U)
      csBundle(0).fuOpType := Cat(Mux(src1IsFp, IF2VectorType.fDup2Vec(2, 0), IF2VectorType.i2Vec(2, 0)), vsewReg)
      csBundle(0).rfWen := false.B
      csBundle(0).fpWen := false.B
      csBundle(0).vecWen := true.B
      /*
      vmv.s.x
       */
      csBundle(1).srcType(0) := SrcType.vp
      csBundle(1).srcType(1) := SrcType.imm
      csBundle(1).srcType(2) := SrcType.vp
      csBundle(1).lsrc(0) := VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL.U
      csBundle(1).lsrc(1) := 0.U
      csBundle(1).lsrc(2) := dest
      csBundle(1).ldest := dest
      csBundle(1).rfWen := false.B
      csBundle(1).fpWen := false.B
      csBundle(1).vecWen := true.B
      csBundle(1).uopIdx := 0.U
    }
    is(UopSplitType.VEC_VXV) {
      /*
      i to vector move
       */
      csBundle(0).srcType(0) := Mux(src1IsImm, SrcType.imm, SrcType.reg)
      csBundle(0).srcType(1) := SrcType.imm
      csBundle(0).srcType(2) := SrcType.imm
      csBundle(0).lsrc(1) := 0.U
      csBundle(0).ldest := VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL.U
      csBundle(0).fuType := FuType.i2v.U
      csBundle(0).fuOpType := Cat(Mux(src1IsImm, IF2VectorType.immDup2Vec(2, 0), IF2VectorType.iDup2Vec(2, 0)), vsewReg)
      csBundle(0).vecWen := true.B
      csBundle(0).vpu.isReverse := false.B
      /*
      LMUL
       */
      for (i <- 0 until MAX_VLMUL) {
        csBundle(i + 1).srcType(0) := SrcType.vp
        csBundle(i + 1).lsrc(0) := VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL.U
        csBundle(i + 1).lsrc(1) := src2 + i.U
        csBundle(i + 1).lsrc(2) := dest + i.U
        csBundle(i + 1).ldest := dest + i.U
        csBundle(i + 1).uopIdx := i.U
      }
    }
    is(UopSplitType.VEC_VVW) {
      for (i <- 0 until MAX_VLMUL / 2) {
        csBundle(2 * i).lsrc(0) := src1 + i.U
        csBundle(2 * i).lsrc(1) := src2 + i.U
        csBundle(2 * i).lsrc(2) := dest + (2 * i).U
        csBundle(2 * i).ldest := dest + (2 * i).U
        csBundle(2 * i).uopIdx := (2 * i).U
        csBundle(2 * i + 1).lsrc(0) := src1 + i.U
        csBundle(2 * i + 1).lsrc(1) := src2 + i.U
        csBundle(2 * i + 1).lsrc(2) := dest + (2 * i + 1).U
        csBundle(2 * i + 1).ldest := dest + (2 * i + 1).U
        csBundle(2 * i + 1).uopIdx := (2 * i + 1).U
      }
    }
    is(UopSplitType.VEC_VFW) {
      /*
      f to vector move
       */
      csBundle(0).srcType(0) := SrcType.fp
      csBundle(0).srcType(1) := SrcType.imm
      csBundle(0).srcType(2) := SrcType.imm
      csBundle(0).lsrc(1) := 0.U
      csBundle(0).ldest := VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL.U
      csBundle(0).fuType := FuType.f2v.U
      csBundle(0).fuOpType := Cat(IF2VectorType.fDup2Vec(2, 0), vsewReg)
      csBundle(0).rfWen := false.B
      csBundle(0).fpWen := false.B
      csBundle(0).vecWen := true.B

      for (i <- 0 until MAX_VLMUL / 2) {
        csBundle(2 * i + 1).srcType(0) := SrcType.vp
        csBundle(2 * i + 1).lsrc(0) := VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL.U
        csBundle(2 * i + 1).lsrc(1) := src2 + i.U
        csBundle(2 * i + 1).lsrc(2) := dest + (2 * i).U
        csBundle(2 * i + 1).ldest := dest + (2 * i).U

          val vecWen = if (i < lmul * nf) true.B else false.B
          val src2Type = if (i < lmul * nf) SrcType.vp else SrcType.no

          csBundle(i + 1).lsrc(0) := VECTOR_TMP_REG_LMUL.U

          csBundle(i + 1).srcType(2) := SrcType.vp

          csBundle(i + 1).ldest := Mux1H(UIntToOH(offsetVd, MAX_VLMUL), (0 until MAX_VLMUL).map(j => dest + j.U))

              }
              is(3.U) {

          }

          }

          }

package xiangshan

import chisel3._
import chisel3.util._

import org.chipsalliance.cde.config.Parameters
import xiangshan.backend.Bundles.DecodedInst

import xiangshan.backend.decode.isa.bitfield.XSInstBitFields

/** Exercises the actual decode tables, uop count generator and legality logic. */
class VDotDecodeHarness(implicit p: Parameters) extends Module {
  val io = IO(new Bundle {
    val inst = Input(UInt(32.W))
    val sew = Input(UInt(2.W))
    val lmul = Input(UInt(3.W))
    val vstart = Input(UInt(8.W))
    val vill = Input(Bool())
    val recognized = Output(Bool())
    val op = Output(UInt(9.W))
    val numUops = Output(UInt(8.W))
    val numWB = Output(UInt(8.W))
    val complex = Output(Bool())
    val illegal = Output(Bool())
  })
  val fields = io.inst.asTypeOf(new XSInstBitFields)
  val decoded = WireInit(0.U.asTypeOf(new DecodedInst))
  decoded.decode(io.inst, VecDecoder.table)
  decoded.lsrc(0) := fields.RS1
  decoded.lsrc(1) := fields.RS2
  decoded.ldest := fields.RD
  val uops = Module(new UopInfoGen)
  uops.io.in.preInfo := 0.U.asTypeOf(uops.io.in.preInfo)
  uops.io.in.preInfo.isVecArith := fields.isVecArith
  uops.io.in.preInfo.typeOfSplit := decoded.uopSplitType
  uops.io.in.preInfo.vsew := io.sew
  uops.io.in.preInfo.vlmul := io.lmul
  val exceptions = Module(new VecExceptionGen)
  exceptions.io.inst := io.inst
  exceptions.io.decodedInst := decoded
  exceptions.io.vtype := 0.U.asTypeOf(exceptions.io.vtype)
  exceptions.io.vtype.vsew := io.sew
  exceptions.io.vtype.vlmul := io.lmul
  exceptions.io.vtype.illegal := io.vill
  exceptions.io.vstart := io.vstart
  io.recognized := XVDot.VDOT_VV === io.inst
  io.op := decoded.fuOpType
  io.numUops := uops.io.out.uopInfo.numOfUop
  io.numWB := uops.io.out.uopInfo.numOfWB
  io.complex := uops.io.out.isComplex
  io.illegal := exceptions.io.illegalInst
}

class VDotDecodeTest extends XSTester {
  behavior of "vdot decode"
  it should "use a unique encoding across all active decode tables" in {
    val tables = XDecode.table ++ FpDecode.table ++ BitmanipDecode.table ++
      ScalarCryptoDecode.table ++ XSTrapDecode.table ++ CBODecode.table ++
      SvinvalDecode.table ++ HypervisorDecode.table ++ VecDecoder.table ++
      ZicondDecode.table ++ ZimopDecode.table ++ ZfaDecode.table
    val dot = XVDot.VDOT_VV
    val overlaps = tables.filter { case (pat, _) =>
      ((pat.value ^ dot.value) & pat.mask & dot.mask) == 0
    }
    overlaps.length shouldBe 1
    overlaps.head._1 shouldBe dot
    (VdotOpType.vdot.litValue >> 7) should not be BigInt(0)
  }
  it should "emit one uop and reject unsupported static configurations" in {
    test(new VDotDecodeHarness).withAnnotations(Seq(VerilatorBackendAnnotation)) { dut =>
      dut.io.sew.poke(0.U)
      dut.io.lmul.poke(0.U)
      dut.io.vstart.poke(0.U)
      dut.io.vill.poke(false.B)
      for (sew <- 0 to 1; vd <- Seq(0, 1, 30, 31); vs1 <- Seq(0, 8, 31); vs2 <- Seq(0, 9, 31)) {
        dut.io.sew.poke(sew.U)
        val word = BigInt(0x0200200b) | (BigInt(vs2) << 20) | (BigInt(vs1) << 15) | (BigInt(vd) << 7)
        dut.io.inst.poke(word.U)
        dut.io.recognized.expect(true.B)
        dut.io.op.expect(0x160.U)
        dut.io.numUops.expect(1.U)
        dut.io.numWB.expect(1.U)
        dut.io.complex.expect(true.B)
        dut.io.illegal.expect(false.B)
      }
      dut.io.inst.poke(0x0294250b.U)
      for (sew <- 2 to 3) {
        dut.io.sew.poke(sew.U)
        dut.io.illegal.expect(true.B)
      }
      dut.io.sew.poke(0.U)
      for (lmul <- 1 to 7) {
        dut.io.lmul.poke(lmul.U)
        dut.io.numUops.expect(1.U)
        dut.io.numWB.expect(1.U)
        dut.io.illegal.expect(true.B)
      }
      dut.io.lmul.poke(0.U)
      dut.io.vstart.poke(1.U)
      dut.io.illegal.expect(true.B)
      dut.io.vstart.poke(0.U)
      dut.io.vill.poke(true.B)
      dut.io.illegal.expect(true.B)
      dut.io.vill.poke(false.B)
      dut.io.inst.poke(0x0094250b.U) // vm=0
      dut.io.illegal.expect(true.B)
      for (word <- Seq(0x0294252bL, 0x0694250bL, 0x0294150bL)) {
        dut.io.inst.poke(word.U)
        dut.io.recognized.expect(false.B)
      }
    }
  }
}

package xiangshan.backend.fu.vector

import chisel3._
import chiseltest._
import org.scalatest.flatspec.AnyFlatSpec
import org.scalatest.matchers.should.Matchers
import scala.util.Random

class VDot8Test extends AnyFlatSpec with ChiselScalatestTester with Matchers {
  private def pack(bytes: Seq[Int], high: BigInt): BigInt =
    (high << 64) | bytes.zipWithIndex.map { case (b, i) => BigInt(b & 255) << (8 * i) }.reduce(_ | _)

  behavior of "VDot8"
  it should "produce exact signed sums with enabled stages, bubbles and poisoned upper bytes" in {
    test(new VDot8).withAnnotations(Seq(VerilatorBackendAnnotation, WriteVcdAnnotation)) { dut =>
      dut.io.sew16.poke(false.B)
      val random = new Random(0x56444f54L)
      val directed = Seq(
        (1 to 8, Seq.fill(8)(1)),
        (1 to 8, (1 to 8).reverse),
        ((1 to 8).map(-_), Seq.fill(8)(1)),
        (Seq.fill(8)(-128), Seq.fill(8)(-128)),
        (Seq.fill(8)(-128), Seq.fill(8)(127)),
        (Seq.fill(8)(127), Seq.fill(8)(127)),
        (Seq.fill(8)(0), Seq.fill(8)(-128))
      )
      val vectors = directed ++ Seq.fill(1000)(
        (Seq.fill(8)(random.nextInt(256) - 128), Seq.fill(8)(random.nextInt(256) - 128)))
      var stage1: Option[BigInt] = None
      var stage2: Option[BigInt] = None
      dut.io.enable.foreach(_.poke(false.B))
      dut.io.vs1.poke(0.U)
      dut.io.vs2.poke(0.U)
      dut.clock.step()
      for ((a, b) <- vectors) {
        // Model each enabled register independently, including simultaneous
        // advance, disabled holds and transfer without a new input.
        for (_ <- 0 until (if (random.nextBoolean()) 1 else 2)) {
          val en1 = random.nextInt(4) != 0
          val en2 = random.nextInt(4) != 0
          val sum = BigInt(a.zip(b).map { case (x, y) => x * y }.sum) & 0xffffffffL
          dut.io.vs1.poke(pack(a, BigInt(64, random)).U)
          dut.io.vs2.poke(pack(b, BigInt(64, random)).U)
          dut.io.enable(0).poke(en1.B)
          dut.io.enable(1).poke(en2.B)
          val next2 = if (en2) stage1 else stage2
          if (en1) stage1 = Some(sum)
          dut.clock.step()
          stage2 = next2
          stage2.foreach(v => dut.io.result.expect(v.U))
        }
      }
      // Explicit endpoint: 18 signed bits cannot hold this result.
      dut.io.vs1.poke(pack(Seq.fill(8)(-128), 0).U)
      dut.io.vs2.poke(pack(Seq.fill(8)(-128), 0).U)
      dut.io.enable(0).poke(true.B)
      dut.io.enable(1).poke(false.B)
      dut.clock.step()
      dut.io.enable(0).poke(false.B)
      dut.io.enable(1).poke(true.B)
      dut.clock.step()
      dut.io.result.expect(BigInt(131072).U)
    }
  }

  it should "hold a negative full-register result while disabled inputs keep changing" in {
    test(new VDot8).withAnnotations(Seq(VerilatorBackendAnnotation)) { dut =>
      dut.io.sew16.poke(false.B)
      dut.io.vs1.poke(pack(Seq.fill(8)(-128), 0).U)
      dut.io.vs2.poke(pack(Seq.fill(8)(127), 0).U)
      dut.io.enable(0).poke(true.B)
      dut.io.enable(1).poke(false.B)
      dut.clock.step()
      dut.io.enable(0).poke(false.B)
      dut.io.enable(1).poke(true.B)
      dut.clock.step()
      val expected = BigInt(-130048) & BigInt("ffffffff", 16)
      dut.io.result.expect(expected.U)
      dut.io.enable.foreach(_.poke(false.B))
      val random = new Random(0x484f4c44L)
      for (_ <- 0 until 96) {
        dut.io.vs1.poke(BigInt(128, random).U)
        dut.io.vs2.poke(BigInt(128, random).U)
        dut.clock.step()
        dut.io.result.expect(expected.U)
      }
      // Stage-one holds must preserve the products for a later transfer too.
      dut.io.enable(1).poke(true.B)
      dut.clock.step()
      dut.io.result.expect(expected.U)
    }
  }

  it should "switch e8 and e16 with independent stage enables and exact wide endpoints across seeds" in {
    test(new VDot8).withAnnotations(Seq(VerilatorBackendAnnotation)) { dut =>
      var s1: Option[BigInt] = None
      var s2: Option[BigInt] = None
      for (seed <- Seq(1L, 0x56444f54L, 0x9e3779b9L, 0xdeadbeefL)) {
        val random = new Random(seed)
        for (n <- 0 until 520) {
          val bits = if (n % 2 == 0) 16 else 8
          val mask = (BigInt(1) << bits) - 1
          val min = -(1 << (bits - 1))
          val a = Seq.fill(8)(if (n < 4) min else random.nextInt(1 << bits) + min)
          val b = Seq.fill(8)(if (n < 2) min else if (n < 4) -min - 1 else random.nextInt(1 << bits) + min)
          def packed(xs: Seq[Int]): BigInt = xs.zipWithIndex.map {
            case (v, i) => (BigInt(v) & mask) << (bits * i)
          }.foldLeft(if (bits == 8) BigInt(64, random) << 64 else BigInt(0))(_ | _)
          val expected = a.zip(b).map { case (x, y) => BigInt(x) * BigInt(y) }.sum &
            ((BigInt(1) << (if (bits == 8) 32 else 64)) - 1)
          val en1 = n < 8 || random.nextInt(4) != 0
          val en2 = n < 8 || random.nextInt(4) != 0
          dut.io.sew16.poke((bits == 16).B)
          dut.io.vs1.poke(packed(a).U)
          dut.io.vs2.poke(packed(b).U)
          dut.io.enable(0).poke(en1.B)
          dut.io.enable(1).poke(en2.B)
          val next = if (en2) s1 else s2
          if (en1) s1 = Some(expected)
          dut.clock.step()
          s2 = next
          s2.foreach(v => dut.io.result.expect(v.U))
        }
      }
      dut.io.enable(0).poke(false.B)
      dut.io.enable(1).poke(true.B)
      dut.clock.step()
      s1.foreach(v => dut.io.result.expect(v.U))
    }
  }
}

    val valid = Input(Bool())
    val cancel = Input(Bool())

    val vxrm = Input(UInt(2.W))
    val config = Input(new VConfig)
    val vm = Input(Bool())
    val vstart = Input(UInt(8.W))
    val v0Dest = Input(Bool())
    val outValid = Output(Bool())
    val outTag = Output(UInt(8.W))
    val result = Output(UInt(128.W))
    val illegal = Output(Bool())
    val saturated = Output(Bool())
    val vecWen = Output(Bool())
    val v0Wen = Output(Bool())

  ctrl.vpu.get.vstart := io.vstart

  data.src(1) := io.vs2
  data.src(2) := io.oldVd
  data.src(cfg.maskSrcIdx) := io.mask
  data.src(cfg.vconfigIdx) := io.config.vl

  val dataPipe = data +: Seq.fill(2)(Reg(chiselTypeOf(data)))

    dataPipe(i) := dataPipe(i - 1)
    validPipe(i) := validPipe(i - 1) && !io.cancel
  }

class VDotIntegrationTest extends XSTester {
  behavior of "VIMacU vdot integration"
  it should "align mixed operations, tags, full writes, runtime legality and canceled operations" in {

      case utility.LogUtilsOptionsKey => utility.LogUtilsOptions(
        enableDebug = false, enablePerf = false, fpgaPlatform = true)
    }
    test(new VDotIntegrationHarness()(testConfig)).withAnnotations(Seq(VerilatorBackendAnnotation, WriteVcdAnnotation)) { dut =>
      case class Expected(tag: Int, data: BigInt, illegal: Boolean, v0: Boolean)
      val byteOnes = BigInt("01" * 16, 16)
      val byteTwos = BigInt("02" * 16, 16)
      var pending = List.fill[Option[Expected]](2)(None)
      var issued = 0
      var checked = 0
      dut.io.valid.poke(false.B)
      dut.io.cancel.poke(false.B)
      dut.io.op.poke(VdotOpType.vdot)
      dut.io.tag.poke(1.U)
      dut.io.vs1.poke(byteOnes.U)
      dut.io.vs2.poke(byteTwos.U)
      dut.io.oldVd.poke(((BigInt(1) << 128) - 1).U)
      dut.io.mask.poke(((BigInt(1) << 128) - 1).U)
      dut.io.vxrm.poke(0.U)
      dut.io.vm.poke(true.B)
      dut.io.vstart.poke(0.U)
      dut.io.v0Dest.poke(false.B)
      dut.io.config.vtype.illegal.poke(false.B)
      dut.io.config.vtype.vta.poke(false.B)
      dut.io.config.vtype.vma.poke(false.B)
      dut.io.config.vtype.vsew.poke(0.U)
      dut.io.config.vtype.vlmul.poke(0.U)
      dut.io.config.vl.poke(8.U)
      dut.clock.step(3)

      def tick(input: Option[Expected], op: BigInt = 0x160, vl: Int = 8,
               vm: Boolean = true, start: Int = 0, cancel: Boolean = false,
               old: BigInt = (BigInt(1) << 128) - 1, sew: Int = 0): Unit = {
        dut.io.valid.poke(input.nonEmpty.B)
        dut.io.cancel.poke(cancel.B)
        dut.io.op.poke(op.U)
        dut.io.config.vl.poke(vl.U)
        dut.io.config.vtype.vsew.poke(sew.U)
        dut.io.vm.poke(vm.B)
        dut.io.vstart.poke(start.U)
        dut.io.oldVd.poke(old.U)
        dut.io.tag.poke(input.map(_.tag).getOrElse(1).U)
        dut.io.v0Dest.poke(input.exists(_.v0).B)
        if (cancel) pending = List(None, None)
        dut.clock.step()
        pending = input.filter(_ => !cancel) :: pending.take(1)
        pending(1) match {
          case Some(e) =>
            dut.io.outValid.expect(true.B)
            dut.io.outTag.expect(e.tag.U)
            dut.io.illegal.expect(e.illegal.B)
            dut.io.saturated.expect(false.B)
            dut.io.vecWen.expect((!e.v0).B)
            dut.io.v0Wen.expect(e.v0.B)
            if (!e.illegal) dut.io.result.expect(e.data.U)
            checked += 1
          case None => dut.io.outValid.expect(false.B)
        }
        if (input.nonEmpty) issued += 1
      }
      for (i <- 1 to 16) {
        val isMul = i % 2 == 0
        dut.io.config.vtype.vta.poke((!isMul && i % 3 == 0).B)
        dut.io.config.vtype.vma.poke((i % 4 == 0).B)
        val result = if (isMul) (byteTwos & ((BigInt(1) << 64) - 1)) else BigInt(16)
        // vl=8/tu preserves old upper bytes for ordinary vmul, never for dot.
        tick(Some(Expected(i, result, false, i % 5 == 0)),
          if (isMul) VimacType.vmul.litValue else BigInt(0x160), old = 0)
        if (i % 3 == 0) tick(None)
      }
      for (vl <- Seq(0, 1, 7, 9, 16)) tick(Some(Expected(20 + vl, 0, true, false)), vl = vl)
      tick(Some(Expected(40, 0, true, false)), vm = false)
      tick(Some(Expected(41, 0, true, false)), start = 1)
      for (vl <- Seq(0, 1, 7, 9)) tick(Some(Expected(50, 0, true, false)), vl = vl, sew = 1)
      tick(Some(Expected(51, 0, true, false)), sew = 2)
      tick(Some(Expected(52, 1056784, false, true)), sew = 1)
      tick(None)
      tick(None)
      tick(Some(Expected(42, 16, false, false)))
      tick(None, cancel = true)
      tick(None)
      tick(Some(Expected(43, 16, false, true)))
      tick(None)
      tick(None)
      checked shouldBe issued - 1
    }
  }

  it should "preserve randomized mixed traffic and ordinary mask tail multiply accumulate and saturation" in {
    val testConfig = config.alterPartial {
      case utility.LogUtilsOptionsKey => utility.LogUtilsOptions(
        enableDebug = false, enablePerf = false, fpgaPlatform = true)
    }
    test(new VDotIntegrationHarness()(testConfig)).withAnnotations(Seq(VerilatorBackendAnnotation, WriteVcdAnnotation)) { dut =>
      var random = new scala.util.Random(0x49534f4cL)
      val full = (BigInt(1) << 128) - 1
      case class Expected(tag: Int, result: BigInt, saturated: Boolean)
      var pending = List.fill[Option[Expected]](2)(None)
      var checked = 0
      var issued = 0
      var killed = 0

      def signed(x: BigInt, width: Int): BigInt =
        if (x.testBit(width - 1)) x - (BigInt(1) << width) else x

      def tick(kind: String, sew: Int = 8, valid: Boolean = true, cancel: Boolean = false,
               forceSat: Boolean = false): Unit = {
        val dot = kind == "dot"
        val width = sew
        val count = 128 / width
        val elemMask = (BigInt(1) << width) - 1
        val a = if (forceSat) BigInt("80" * 16, 16) else BigInt(128, random)
        val b = if (forceSat) a else BigInt(128, random)
        val old = BigInt(128, random)
        val mask = BigInt(128, random)
        val vl = if (dot) 8 else if (forceSat) count else random.nextInt(count + 1)
        val vm = dot || forceSat || random.nextBoolean()
        val ta = random.nextBoolean()
        val ma = random.nextBoolean()
        val tag = issued % 63 + 1
        val op = kind match {
          case "dot" => VdotOpType.vdot
          case "mul" => VimacType.vmul
          case "macc" => VimacType.vmacc
          case "madd" => VimacType.vmadd
          case "nmsac" => VimacType.vnmsac
          case "smul" => VimacType.vsmul
        }
        var sat = false
        val result = if (dot) {
          (0 until 8).map { i =>
            signed((a >> (width * i)) & elemMask, width) * signed((b >> (width * i)) & elemMask, width)
          }.sum & ((BigInt(1) << (if (width == 8) 32 else 64)) - 1)
        } else {
          (0 until count).map { i =>
            val x = signed((a >> (width * i)) & elemMask, width)
            val y = signed((b >> (width * i)) & elemMask, width)
            val z = (old >> (width * i)) & elemMask
            val active = i < vl && (vm || mask.testBit(i))
            val product = kind match {
              case "mul" => x * y
              case "macc" => x * y + z
              case "madd" => x * signed(z, width) + y
              case "nmsac" => z - x * y
              case "smul" =>
                val overflow = x == -(BigInt(1) << (width - 1)) && x == y
                if (active && overflow) sat = true
                if (overflow) (BigInt(1) << (width - 1)) - 1 else (x * y) >> (width - 1)
            }
            // vstart >= vl preserves the whole destination, even with ta/ma.
            val value = if (vl == 0) z else if (active) product & elemMask
              else if ((i >= vl && ta) || (i < vl && ma)) elemMask else z
            value << (width * i)
          }.foldLeft(BigInt(0))(_ | _)
        }
        dut.io.valid.poke(valid.B)
        dut.io.cancel.poke(cancel.B)
        dut.io.op.poke(op)
        dut.io.tag.poke(tag.U)
        dut.io.vs1.poke(a.U)
        dut.io.vs2.poke(b.U)
        dut.io.oldVd.poke(old.U)
        dut.io.mask.poke(mask.U)
        dut.io.vxrm.poke(2.U) // RDN: signed arithmetic shift in the oracle.
        dut.io.vm.poke(vm.B)
        dut.io.vstart.poke(0.U)
        dut.io.v0Dest.poke(false.B)
        dut.io.config.vtype.illegal.poke(false.B)
        dut.io.config.vtype.vta.poke(ta.B)
        dut.io.config.vtype.vma.poke(ma.B)
        dut.io.config.vtype.vsew.poke(Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(width / 8).U)
        dut.io.config.vtype.vlmul.poke(0.U)
        dut.io.config.vl.poke(vl.U)
        if (cancel) {
          killed += pending.take(1).count(_.nonEmpty)
          pending = List(None, None)
        }
        val input = if (valid && !cancel) Some(Expected(tag, result & full, sat)) else None
        dut.clock.step()
        pending = input :: pending.take(1)
        pending(1) match {
          case Some(e) =>
            dut.io.outValid.expect(true.B)
            dut.io.outTag.expect(e.tag.U)
            dut.io.illegal.expect(false.B)
            dut.io.result.expect(e.result.U)
            dut.io.saturated.expect(e.saturated.B)
            checked += 1
          case None => dut.io.outValid.expect(false.B)
        }
        if (input.nonEmpty) issued += 1
      }

      for (_ <- 0 until 3) tick("mul", valid = false)
      // Long homogeneous windows also supply switching/hold audit evidence.
      for (_ <- 0 until 32) tick("dot")
      for (_ <- 0 until 32) tick("mul", sew = 32)
      for (seed <- Seq(0x49534f4cL, 1L, 0x9e3779b9L, 0xdeadbeefL); i <- 0 until 240) {
        if (i == 0) random = new scala.util.Random(seed)
        val kinds = Seq("dot", "mul", "macc", "madd", "nmsac", "smul")
        val kind = kinds(i % kinds.size)
        tick(kind, sew = if (kind == "dot") Seq(8, 16)((i / 6) % 2)
          else Seq(8, 16, 32, 64)((i / 6) % 4))
        if (i % 11 == 0) tick("mul", valid = false)
        if (i % 37 == 0) tick("dot", valid = false, cancel = true)
      }
      tick("smul", forceSat = true)
      tick("dot")
      tick("smul", forceSat = true)
      for (_ <- 0 until 12) tick("mul", valid = false)
      checked shouldBe issued - killed
      println(s"e8/e16 isolation functional PASS: issued=$issued checked=$checked canceled=$killed seeds=4")
    }
  }
}

    for j,i in enumerate((1,3,5,7)):

    start=text.index('inline void Emulator::single_cycle()')
    pos=text.index('  dut_ptr->eval();',text.index('  dut_ptr->clock = 0;',start))+len('  dut_ptr->eval();')
    text=text[:pos]+'\n  e16events::sample_model(dut_ptr->rootp, cycles);'+text[pos:]
    emu.write_text(text)
    shutil.copy2(SRC/'collector.h',BUILD/'emulator/collector.h')
    args=['make','-C',XS/'difftest',f'BUILD_DIR={BUILD}',f'RTL_DIR={BASE/"rtl"}',
      f'DESIGN_DIR={XS}','NUM_CORES=1','WITH_DRAMSIM3=1','WITH_CONSTANTIN=0',
      'EMU_THREADS=0','EMU_TRACE=0',f'EMU_CSRC_DIR={BUILD/"emulator"}','-j2']
    env=os.environ.copy();env['NOOP_HOME']=str(XS);env['NEMU_HOME']=str(ROOT.parent/'NEMU')

    env['VEXTRA_FLAGS']=str(SRC/'visibility.vlt')
    run(args+[str(BUILD/'emu-compile/VSimTop.mk')],env=env)
    generate_fields()
    run(args+['build_emu'],env=env)
    assert all(sha(p)==h for p,h in inputs.items()),'frozen input changed'
    (BUILD/'complete.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(status='PASS',emu_sha256=sha(BUILD/'emu'),
      rtl_source='sew16-fixed8/rtl',waveform=False,mode='read-only public_flat_rd and C++ settled-low events'),indent=2))
    print('[event build COMPLETE]',BUILD/'emu',flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Replay the frozen original full image; locate and capture e2e windows."""
import datetime
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OLD = ROOT/'stage3/logs/20261006T060358-16-isolation-perf-full-run0-20261006T063347-16-bench.full.log'
COMMIT = re.compile(r'\[\d{2}\] commit pc ([0-9a-f]+) inst ([0-9a-f]+) wen (\d+) dst (\d+) data ([0-9a-f]+) idx [0-9a-f]+[^\n]*\n')

def need(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)

def sha(path):
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()

def module(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    result = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(result)
    return result

def write(path, value):
    with path.open('x') as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2)
        stream.write('\n')

def calibrate(path):
    scope, selected, values, offsets = [], {}, {}, []
    time, clock = 0, None
    def sample():
        nonlocal clock
        current=values.get('clock')
        if clock==1 and current==0 and 'mcycle' in values and 'cycle' in values:
            offsets.append(dict(time=time,mcycle=values['mcycle'],cycle=values['cycle'],offset=(values['mcycle']-values['cycle']) % (1<<64)))
        clock=current
    with path.open() as stream:
        header=True
        for line in stream:
            line=line.strip()
            fields=line.split()
            if header:
                if line.startswith('$scope'): scope.append(fields[2])
                elif line.startswith('$upscope'): scope.pop()
                elif line.startswith('$var'):
                    name='.'.join(scope+[fields[4]])
                    if name=='TOP.clock': selected[fields[3]]='clock'
                    elif name.endswith('.csr.csrMod.mcycle.reg_ALL'): selected[fields[3]]='mcycle'
                    elif name.endswith('.rob.difftest_module_8.io_bits_cycleCnt'): selected[fields[3]]='cycle'
                elif line.startswith('$enddefinitions'):
                    need(set(selected.values())=={'clock','mcycle','cycle'}, 'missing boot calibration signals: '+str(selected))
                    header=False
                continue
            if line.startswith('#'):
                sample(); time=int(line[1:])
            elif line.startswith('b'):
                bits,code=line[1:].split()
                if code in selected and not re.search('[xz]',bits): values[selected[code]]=int(bits,2)
            elif line[:1] in ('0','1') and line[1:].strip() in selected:
                values[selected[line[1:].strip()]]=int(line[0])
    sample()
    stable=[x for x in offsets if x['cycle']>=8]
    need(len(stable)>=8 and len({x['offset'] for x in stable})==1, 'unstable mcycle/trap calibration')
    return dict(offset=stable[-1]['offset'],samples=stable,wave_sha256=sha(path),qualification='short boot calibration only, NOT full architectural regression')

def windows(text):
    """Original ELF PCs, never inferred from changed diagnostic ELF layouts."""
    pending = None
    pairs = []
    for match in COMMIT.finditer(text):
        pc, inst, wen, dst, data = match.groups()
        pc, inst, data = int(pc,16), int(inst,16), int(data,16)
        if pc in (0x8000034c, 0x800003d4, 0x80000448, 0x800004a0):
            need(pending is None and inst == 0xb0002373 and (wen,dst)==('1','06'), 'invalid start timestamp')
            pending = dict(start=data, start_pc=hex(pc))
        elif pc == 0x800004c8:
            need(pending is not None and inst == 0xb0002e73 and (wen,dst)==('1','28'), 'invalid end timestamp')
            pending.update(end=data, cycles=data-pending['start'])
            pairs.append(pending)

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

BASE = "TOP.SimTop.l_soc.core_with_l2.core.backend."
CTRL = BASE + "inner_ctrlBlock."
DISPATCH = CTRL + "dispatch."
ROB = CTRL + "rob."
FU = BASE + "inner_vfExuBlock.exus.Vimac."
SYMBOLS = ("control_branch_pc", "control_branch_dot", "control_branch_dot_v0",
           "control_exception_pc", "control_younger_dot", "control_younger_dot_v0",
           "control_younger_dot_alias", "control_exception_resume")
# Pinned DefaultConfig: 160 entries, eight value bits plus one wrap flag.
# Encoded pointer ordering uses a 256 stride, NOT 160. Unused values are
# rejected; modulo-512 differences are ordering comparisons, not uop counts.
ROB_SIZE = 160
PRINTED_SYMBOLS = dict(branch="control_branch_pc", branch_dot="control_branch_dot",
                       branch_v0="control_branch_dot_v0", illegal="control_exception_pc",
                       young="control_younger_dot", young_v0="control_younger_dot_v0",
                       young_alias="control_younger_dot_alias")


def need(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)


def digest(path):
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()


def audit_log(path, seed):
    text = Path(path).read_text(errors="replace")
    text = re.sub(r"\x1b\[[0-9;]*[a-zA-Z]", "", text)
    # A UART line can be split by complete commit-trace lines. Removing the
    # complete trace INCLUDING its newline rejoins the original UART text.
    text = re.sub(r"\[\d{2}\] commit pc [0-9a-f]+ inst [0-9a-f]+ wen \d+ dst \d+ data [0-9a-f]+ idx [0-9a-f]+[^\n]*\n", "", text)
    expected = (f"control PASS: seed={int(seed,16):x} random=256 branch_train=64 "
                "branch_probe=4 illegal=20 configs=24 config_faults=16 mixed=16x32 chains=16x128")
    need("Difftest enabled" in text and "HIT GOOD TRAP" in text and expected in text,
         "missing exact full-core control PASS/seed/coverage")
    need(not re.search(r"HIT BAD TRAP|ABORT|different at pc|control.*FAIL", text), "core failure")
    need(re.findall(r"^\[process exit\] (\d+)$", text, re.M) == ["0"], "missing actual zero process exit")
    pattern = "control symbols " + " ".join(n+r"=([0-9a-f]+)" for n in PRINTED_SYMBOLS)
    rows = re.findall(pattern, text)
    need(len(rows) == 1, "missing/duplicate runtime symbol report")
    printed = {PRINTED_SYMBOLS[n]:int(v,16) for n,v in zip(PRINTED_SYMBOLS,rows[0])}
    return dict(seed=seed, log_sha256=digest(path), architectural_status="PASS", printed_symbols=printed)


def read_symbols(path):
    # riscv64-linux-gnu-nm -n ELF, frozen alongside each control image.
    found = {}
    for row in Path(path).read_text().splitlines():
        fields = row.split()
        if len(fields) == 3 and fields[2] in SYMBOLS:
            found[fields[2]] = int(fields[0], 16)
    need(set(found) == set(SYMBOLS), "missing ELF control symbols")
    need(len(set(found.values())) == len(SYMBOLS), "duplicate control symbol addresses")
    return found


def required_signals():
    names = ["TOP.clock", DISPATCH+"io_enqRob_canAccept",
             CTRL+"io_redirect_valid", CTRL+"io_redirect_bits_level",
             ROB+"io_flushOut_valid", ROB+"io_flushOut_bits_level",
             ROB+"io_exception_valid", ROB+"io_exception_bits_exceptionVec_2",
             ROB+"io_exception_bits_instr",
             ROB+"io_commits_isCommit", FU+"io_out_valid",
             FU+"io_in_bits_ctrlPipe_2_fuOpType", FU+"io_out_bits_res_data"]
    for prefix in (CTRL+"io_redirect_bits_", ROB+"io_flushOut_bits_", FU+"io_out_bits_ctrl_"):
        names += [prefix+"robIdx_"+n for n in ("flag", "value")]
    for i in range(6):
        prefix = DISPATCH+f"io_enqRob_req_{i}_"
        names += [prefix+"valid"] + [prefix+"bits_"+n for n in ("instr", "pc", "robIdx_flag", "robIdx_value")]
    for i in range(8):
        names += [ROB+f"io_commits_commitValid_{i}"]
        names += [ROB+f"io_commits_robIdx_{i}_"+n for n in ("flag", "value")]
    for i in (1, 3, 5, 7):
        prefix = CTRL+f"io_fromWB_wbData_{i}_"
        names += [prefix+"valid", prefix+"bits_redirect_valid"]
        names += [prefix+"bits_redirect_bits_"+n for n in
                  ("robIdx_flag", "robIdx_value", "cfiUpdate_pc", "cfiUpdate_taken", "cfiUpdate_isMisPred")]
    return names


def audit_wave(path, symbols, require_coverage=True):
