    # This pinned XS treats a CSR WRITE as waitForward+blockBackward; unlike
    # read-only mcycle, csrwi vstart is not relaxed by Rename. Requires VS on.
    # Pre-start drain is outside the interval. The next two drains are INSIDE.
    # Both implementations pay the same markers; never subtract an empty loop.
    .macro timer_start
    csrwi vstart, 0
    csrr t1, mcycle
    csrwi vstart, 0
    .endm
    .macro timer_end
    csrwi vstart, 0
    csrr t3, mcycle
    .endm
    .macro dot vd, vs1=8
    .4byte ((1 << 25) | (9 << 20) | (\vs1 << 15) | (2 << 12) | (\vd << 7) | 0x0b)
    .endm
    .macro clear_outputs
    vsetivli zero, 4, e32, m1, tu, mu
    vmv.v.i v12, 0
    vmv.v.i v14, 0
    vmv.v.i v18, 0
    vmv.v.i v22, 0
    vmv.v.i v26, 0
    vsetivli zero, 8, e8, m1, tu, mu
    .endm
    .macro rvv_batch
    # Product groups 16:17/20:21/24:25/28:29 do not overlap sources,
    # seed v12, or destinations 14/18/22/26. Each dot sums EXACT i16
    # products into i32; tu preserves the previously cleared upper96.
    vwmul.vv v16, v8, v9
    vwmul.vv v20, v8, v9
    vwmul.vv v24, v8, v9
    vwmul.vv v28, v8, v9
    vsetivli zero, 8, e16, m2, tu, mu
    vwredsum.vs v14, v16, v12
    vwredsum.vs v18, v20, v12
    vwredsum.vs v22, v24, v12
    vwredsum.vs v26, v28, v12
    vsetivli zero, 8, e8, m1, tu, mu
    .endm
    .macro dot_batch
    dot 14
    dot 18
    dot 22
    dot 26
    .endm
    .macro store_outputs
    vs1r.v v14, (a0)
    addi t2, a0, 16
    vs1r.v v18, (t2)
    addi t2, a0, 32
    vs1r.v v22, (t2)
    addi t2, a0, 48
    vs1r.v v26, (t2)
    .endm
    .globl bench_compute
    .type bench_compute, @function
# a0=16-byte output, a1/a2=16-byte sources, a3=baseline, a4=policy.
bench_compute:
    vl1re8.v v8, (a1)
    vl1re8.v v9, (a2)
    vsetivli zero, 4, e32, m1, tu, mu
    vmv.v.i v10, 0
    vmv.v.i v12, 0
    vsetivli zero, 8, e8, m1, tu, mu
    beqz a3, .Lcompute_dot
    vwmul.vv v16, v8, v9
    vsetivli zero, 8, e16, m2, tu, mu
    vwredsum.vs v10, v16, v12
    j .Lcompute_done
.Lcompute_dot:
    # Dot's ta/ma-independence is tested at the actual instruction as well.
    li t0, 8
    vsetvl zero, t0, a4
    .4byte 0x0294250b
.Lcompute_done:
    li t0, 8
    vsetvl zero, t0, a4
    vs1r.v v10, (a0)
    ret
    .size bench_compute, .-bench_compute

    .globl bench_kernel
    .type bench_kernel, @function
# a3=baseline, a4=0 preloaded batch4 / 1 loads+init+stores / 2 feedback chain.
# a5 is a positive batch count. Both impls execute a5 batches of four dots.
# CSR timestamps+scalar loop work
# are identical; baseline configuration changes are intrinsically required.
bench_kernel:
    vl1re8.v v8, (a1)
    vl1re8.v v9, (a2)
    clear_outputs
    mv t0, a5
    li t4, 2
    beq a4, t4, .Lchain
    beqz a3, .Lkernel_dot
    timer_start
.Lrvv_loop:
    beqz a4, .Lrvv_compute
    vl1re8.v v8, (a1)
    vl1re8.v v9, (a2)
    clear_outputs
.Lrvv_compute:
    rvv_batch
    beqz a4, .Lrvv_next
    store_outputs
.Lrvv_next:
    addi t0, t0, -1
    bnez t0, .Lrvv_loop
    j .Lkernel_done
.Lkernel_dot:
    timer_start
.Ldot_loop:
    beqz a4, .Ldot_compute
    vl1re8.v v8, (a1)
    vl1re8.v v9, (a2)
    clear_outputs
.Ldot_compute:
    dot_batch
    beqz a4, .Ldot_next
    store_outputs
.Ldot_next:
    addi t0, t0, -1
    bnez t0, .Ldot_loop
    j .Lkernel_done
.Lchain:
    # Zero input is a stable fixed point, but the explicit feedback source
    # creates a real architectural vector dependency on every instruction.
    beqz a3, .Lchain_dot
    timer_start
.Lchain_rvv_loop:
    .rept 4
    vwmul.vv v16, v14, v9
    vsetivli zero, 8, e16, m2, tu, mu
    vwredsum.vs v14, v16, v12
    vsetivli zero, 8, e8, m1, tu, mu
    .endr
    addi t0, t0, -1
    bnez t0, .Lchain_rvv_loop
    j .Lkernel_done
.Lchain_dot:
    timer_start
.Lchain_dot_loop:
    .rept 4
    dot 14, 14
    .endr
    addi t0, t0, -1
    bnez t0, .Lchain_dot_loop
    j .Lkernel_done
.Lkernel_done:
    # Same unconditional jump on both paths.
    timer_end
    sub t3, t3, t1
    store_outputs
    mv a0, t3
    ret
    .size bench_kernel, .-bench_kernel

    .type bench_empty, @function
bench_empty:
    timer_start
.Lempty:
    addi a0, a0, -1

    # 与只读 mcycle 不同，Rename 不会放宽 csrwi vstart，且执行时需启用 VS。
    # 起始前排空在计时外，后两个排空位于计时区间内部。
    # 两种实现承担相同标记成本，不扣除空循环时间。
    .macro timer_start
    csrwi vstart, 0
    csrr t1, mcycle
    csrwi vstart, 0
    .endm
    .macro timer_end
    csrwi vstart, 0
    csrr t3, mcycle
    .endm
    .macro dot vd, vs1=8
    .4byte ((1 << 25) | (9 << 20) | (\vs1 << 15) | (2 << 12) | (\vd << 7) | 0x0b)
    .endm
    .macro clear_outputs
    vsetivli zero, 4, e32, m1, tu, mu
    vmv.v.i v12, 0
    vmv.v.i v14, 0
    vmv.v.i v18, 0
    vmv.v.i v22, 0
    vmv.v.i v26, 0
    vsetivli zero, 8, e8, m1, tu, mu
    .endm
    .macro rvv_batch
    # 乘积寄存器组 16:17、20:21、24:25、28:29 不与源、
    # 零种子 v12 或目的 14/18/22/26 重叠；每次点积将精确 i16
    # 乘积归约到 i32，tu 保留预先清零的高 96 位。
    vwmul.vv v16, v8, v9
    vwmul.vv v20, v8, v9
    vwmul.vv v24, v8, v9
    vwmul.vv v28, v8, v9
    vsetivli zero, 8, e16, m2, tu, mu
    vwredsum.vs v14, v16, v12
    vwredsum.vs v18, v20, v12
    vwredsum.vs v22, v24, v12
    vwredsum.vs v26, v28, v12
    vsetivli zero, 8, e8, m1, tu, mu
    .endm
    .macro dot_batch
    dot 14
    dot 18
    dot 22
    dot 26
    .endm
    .macro store_outputs
    vs1r.v v14, (a0)
    addi t2, a0, 16
    vs1r.v v18, (t2)
    addi t2, a0, 32
    vs1r.v v22, (t2)
    addi t2, a0, 48
    vs1r.v v26, (t2)
    .endm
    .globl bench_compute
    .type bench_compute, @function
# 参数：a0 为 16 字节输出，a1/a2 为 16 字节源，a3 选基线，a4 选策略。
bench_compute:
    vl1re8.v v8, (a1)
    vl1re8.v v9, (a2)
    vsetivli zero, 4, e32, m1, tu, mu
    vmv.v.i v10, 0
    vmv.v.i v12, 0
    vsetivli zero, 8, e8, m1, tu, mu
    beqz a3, .Lcompute_dot
    vwmul.vv v16, v8, v9
    vsetivli zero, 8, e16, m2, tu, mu
    vwredsum.vs v10, v16, v12
    j .Lcompute_done
.Lcompute_dot:
    # 同时在实际点积指令处检查结果不依赖 ta/ma。
    li t0, 8
    vsetvl zero, t0, a4
    .4byte 0x0294250b
.Lcompute_done:
    li t0, 8
    vsetvl zero, t0, a4
    vs1r.v v10, (a0)
    ret
    .size bench_compute, .-bench_compute

    .globl bench_kernel
    .type bench_kernel, @function
# a3 选择基线；a4=0 预加载批处理、1 加载/初始化/存储、2 反馈链。
# a5 为正批次数；两种实现均执行 a5 批，每批四次点积。
# 两种实现使用相同的 CSR 时间戳与标量循环开销；
# 基线额外配置切换属于其算法本身所需的成本。
bench_kernel:
    vl1re8.v v8, (a1)
    vl1re8.v v9, (a2)
    clear_outputs
    mv t0, a5
    li t4, 2
    beq a4, t4, .Lchain
    beqz a3, .Lkernel_dot
    timer_start
.Lrvv_loop:
    beqz a4, .Lrvv_compute
    vl1re8.v v8, (a1)
    vl1re8.v v9, (a2)
    clear_outputs
.Lrvv_compute:

    bnez t0, .Lrvv_loop
    j .Lkernel_done
.Lkernel_dot:
    timer_start
.Ldot_loop:
    beqz a4, .Ldot_compute
    vl1re8.v v8, (a1)
    vl1re8.v v9, (a2)
    clear_outputs
.Ldot_compute:
    dot_batch
    beqz a4, .Ldot_next
    store_outputs
.Ldot_next:
    addi t0, t0, -1
    bnez t0, .Ldot_loop
    j .Lkernel_done
.Lchain:
    # 零输入虽然是稳定不动点，但显式反馈源
    # 仍在每条指令间建立真实的架构向量依赖。
    beqz a3, .Lchain_dot
    timer_start
.Lchain_rvv_loop:
    .rept 4
    vwmul.vv v16, v14, v9
    vsetivli zero, 8, e16, m2, tu, mu
    vwredsum.vs v14, v16, v12
    vsetivli zero, 8, e8, m1, tu, mu
    .endr
    addi t0, t0, -1
    bnez t0, .Lchain_rvv_loop
    j .Lkernel_done
.Lchain_dot:
    timer_start
.Lchain_dot_loop:
    .rept 4
    dot 14, 14
    .endr
    addi t0, t0, -1
    bnez t0, .Lchain_dot_loop
    j .Lkernel_done
.Lkernel_done:
    # 两条路径执行相同的无条件跳转。
    timer_end
    sub t3, t3, t1
    store_outputs
    mv a0, t3
    ret
    .size bench_kernel, .-bench_kernel

    .globl bench_empty
    .type bench_empty, @function
bench_empty:
    timer_start
.Lempty:
    addi a0, a0, -1
    bnez a0, .Lempty
    timer_end
    sub a0, t3, t1
    ret
    .size bench_empty, .-bench_empty
    .option pop

@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+package xiangshan.backend.fu.vector
+
+import chisel3._
+import chisel3.util._
+
+/** Two explicitly enabled stages: full signed products, then exact reduction.
+  * The owner supplies stage enables from its control pipeline. Valid/flush and
+  * destination tags remain in the existing vector execution interface.
+  */
+class VDot8 extends Module {
+  val io = IO(new Bundle {
+    val vs1 = Input(UInt(128.W))
+    val vs2 = Input(UInt(128.W))
+    val sew16 = Input(Bool())
+    val enable = Input(Vec(2, Bool()))
+    val result = Output(UInt(128.W))
+  })
+
+  // Register enables alone do not isolate the combinational multipliers.
+  // Eight shared signed 16x16 multipliers. e8 selects/sign-extends the low
+  // eight bytes; e16 consumes all eight halfwords. Clamp BEFORE arithmetic.
+  val isolatedVs1 = Mux(io.enable(0), io.vs1, 0.U(128.W))
+  val isolatedVs2 = Mux(io.enable(0), io.vs2, 0.U(128.W))
+  val activeSew16 = io.enable(0) && io.sew16
+  val sew16S1 = RegEnable(io.sew16, io.enable(0))
+  val sew16S2 = RegEnable(sew16S1, io.enable(1))
+  def operand(src: UInt, i: Int): SInt = {
+    val byte = src(8 * i + 7, 8 * i)
+    Mux(activeSew16, src(16 * i + 15, 16 * i),
+      Cat(Fill(8, byte(7)), byte)).asSInt
+  }
+  val products = Reg(Vec(8, SInt(32.W)))
+  when(io.enable(0)) {
+    for (i <- 0 until 8) {
+      products(i) := operand(isolatedVs1, i) * operand(isolatedVs2, i)
+    }
+  }
+  val pairs = (0 until 4).map(i => products(2 * i) +& products(2 * i + 1))
+  val quads = (0 until 2).map(i => pairs(2 * i) +& pairs(2 * i + 1))
+  val sum = RegEnable(quads(0) +& quads(1), io.enable(1))
+  require(sum.getWidth == 35)
+  val sum32 = Wire(SInt(32.W))
+  sum32 := sum // e8 range fits exactly; e16 uses the separate 64-bit packing.
+  val sum64 = Wire(SInt(64.W))
+  sum64 := sum
+  io.result := Mux(sew16S2, Cat(0.U(64.W), sum64.asUInt),
+    Cat(0.U(96.W), sum32.asUInt))
+}

+  ctrl.v0Wen.get := io.v0Dest

+  data.src(1) := io.vs2
+  data.src(2) := io.oldVd

+  data.src(cfg.vconfigIdx) := io.config.vl

+  val dataPipe = data +: Seq.fill(2)(Reg(chiselTypeOf(data)))
+  val validPipe = (io.valid && !io.cancel) +: Seq.fill(2)(RegInit(false.B))

diff --git a/src/main/scala/xiangshan/backend/fu/vector/VDot8.scala b/src/main/scala/xiangshan/backend/fu/vector/VDot8.scala
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..5b1e8a25e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/main/scala/xiangshan/backend/fu/vector/VDot8.scala
@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+package xiangshan.backend.fu.vector
+
+import chisel3._
+import chisel3.util._
+
+/** 两级显式使能流水：第一级保存完整有符号乘积，第二级精确归约。
+  * 外层控制流水提供各级使能；有效、取消及目的标签沿用既有向量执行接口。
+  */
+class VDot8 extends Module {
+  val io = IO(new Bundle {
+    val vs1 = Input(UInt(128.W))
+    val vs2 = Input(UInt(128.W))
+    val sew16 = Input(Bool())
+    val enable = Input(Vec(2, Bool()))
+    val result = Output(UInt(128.W))
+  })
+
+  // 仅保持寄存器不能隔离组合乘法器，输入仍需在算术之前夹零。
+  // e8/e16 共用八个有符号 16×16 乘法器；e8 选择低八字节并符号扩展，
+  // e16 使用全部八个半字。操作数夹零必须放在算术逻辑之前。
+  val isolatedVs1 = Mux(io.enable(0), io.vs1, 0.U(128.W))
+  val isolatedVs2 = Mux(io.enable(0), io.vs2, 0.U(128.W))
+  val activeSew16 = io.enable(0) && io.sew16
+  val sew16S1 = RegEnable(io.sew16, io.enable(0))
+  val sew16S2 = RegEnable(sew16S1, io.enable(1))
+  def operand(src: UInt, i: Int): SInt = {
+    val byte = src(8 * i + 7, 8 * i)
+    Mux(activeSew16, src(16 * i + 15, 16 * i),
+      Cat(Fill(8, byte(7)), byte)).asSInt
+  }
+  val products = Reg(Vec(8, SInt(32.W)))
+  when(io.enable(0)) {
+    for (i <- 0 until 8) {
+      products(i) := operand(isolatedVs1, i) * operand(isolatedVs2, i)
+    }
+  }
+  val pairs = (0 until 4).map(i => products(2 * i) +& products(2 * i + 1))
+  val quads = (0 until 2).map(i => pairs(2 * i) +& pairs(2 * i + 1))
+  val sum = RegEnable(quads(0) +& quads(1), io.enable(1))
+  require(sum.getWidth == 35)
+  val sum32 = Wire(SInt(32.W))
+  sum32 := sum // e8 的精确结果可完整放入 32 位；e16 使用独立的 64 位打包路径。
+  val sum64 = Wire(SInt(64.W))
+  sum64 := sum
+  io.result := Mux(sew16S2, Cat(0.U(64.W), sum64.asUInt),
+    Cat(0.U(96.W), sum32.asUInt))
+}

+  split.io.vtypeBypass := 0.U.asTypeOf(split.io.vtypeBypass)
+  split.io.in.valid := io.valid
+  split.io.in.bits.simpleDecodedInst := decoded
+  split.io.in.bits.uopInfo := uops.io.out.uopInfo
+  split.io.out.complexDecodedInsts.foreach(_.ready := true.B)
+  io.ready := split.io.in.ready
+  val out = split.io.out.complexDecodedInsts.head
+  io.outValid := out.valid
+  for (i <- 0 until 3) {
+    io.srcType(i) := out.bits.srcType(i)
+    io.lsrc(i) := out.bits.lsrc(i)
+  }
+  io.ldest := out.bits.ldest
+}
+
+class VDotSplitTest extends XSTester {
+  behavior of "vdot complex split old destination elimination"
+  it should "remove only the third dot source and preserve true aliases and ordinary MAC" in {
+    val testConfig = config.alterPartial {
+      case utility.LogUtilsOptionsKey => utility.LogUtilsOptions(
+        enableDebug = false, enablePerf = false, fpgaPlatform = true)
+    }
+    test(new VDotSplitHarness()(testConfig)).withAnnotations(Seq(VerilatorBackendAnnotation)) { dut =>
+      dut.io.valid.poke(false.B)
+      dut.io.inst.poke(0.U)
+      dut.clock.step(2)
+      def check(word: BigInt, vd: Int, vs1: Int, vs2: Int, oldType: BigInt): Unit = {
+        var limit = 0
+        while (!dut.io.ready.peek().litToBoolean && limit < 10) { dut.clock.step(); limit += 1 }
+        dut.io.ready.expect(true.B)
+        dut.io.inst.poke(word.U)
+        dut.io.valid.poke(true.B)
+        dut.clock.step()
+        dut.io.valid.poke(false.B)
+        limit = 0
+        while (!dut.io.outValid.peek().litToBoolean && limit < 10) { dut.clock.step(); limit += 1 }
+        dut.io.outValid.expect(true.B)
+        dut.io.srcType(0).expect(SrcType.vp)
+        dut.io.srcType(1).expect(SrcType.vp)
+        dut.io.srcType(2).expect(oldType.U)
+        dut.io.lsrc(0).expect(vs1.U)
+        dut.io.lsrc(1).expect(vs2.U)
+        dut.io.ldest.expect(vd.U)
+        dut.clock.step(2)
+      }
+      for (vd <- Seq(0, 8, 9, 31); vs1 <- Seq(0, 8, 31); vs2 <- Seq(0, 9, 31)) {
+        val word = BigInt(0x0200200b) | (BigInt(vs2) << 20) | (BigInt(vs1) << 15) | (BigInt(vd) << 7)
+        check(word,vd,vs1,vs2,SrcType.no.litValue)
+      }
+      // vmacc.vv v10,v9,v8：确实需要旧目的值参与运算的对照指令。
+      check(BigInt(0xb6942557L),10,8,9,SrcType.vp.litValue)
+    }
+  }
+}

+package xiangshan.backend.fu.vector
+
+import chisel3._
+import chiseltest._
+import org.scalatest.flatspec.AnyFlatSpec
+import org.scalatest.matchers.should.Matchers
+import scala.util.Random
+
+class VDot8Test extends AnyFlatSpec with ChiselScalatestTester with Matchers {
+  private def pack(bytes: Seq[Int], high: BigInt): BigInt =
+    (high << 64) | bytes.zipWithIndex.map { case (b, i) => BigInt(b & 255) << (8 * i) }.reduce(_ | _)
+
+  behavior of "VDot8"
+  it should "produce exact signed sums with enabled stages, bubbles and poisoned upper bytes" in {
+    test(new VDot8).withAnnotations(Seq(VerilatorBackendAnnotation, WriteVcdAnnotation)) { dut =>
+      dut.io.sew16.poke(false.B)
+      val random = new Random(0x56444f54L)
+      val directed = Seq(
+        (1 to 8, Seq.fill(8)(1)),
+        (1 to 8, (1 to 8).reverse),
+        ((1 to 8).map(-_), Seq.fill(8)(1)),
+        (Seq.fill(8)(-128), Seq.fill(8)(-128)),
+        (Seq.fill(8)(-128), Seq.fill(8)(127)),
+        (Seq.fill(8)(127), Seq.fill(8)(127)),
+        (Seq.fill(8)(0), Seq.fill(8)(-128))
+      )
+      val vectors = directed ++ Seq.fill(1000)(
+        (Seq.fill(8)(random.nextInt(256) - 128), Seq.fill(8)(random.nextInt(256) - 128)))
+      var stage1: Option[BigInt] = None
+      var stage2: Option[BigInt] = None
+      dut.io.enable.foreach(_.poke(false.B))
+      dut.io.vs1.poke(0.U)
+      dut.io.vs2.poke(0.U)
+      dut.clock.step()
+      for ((a, b) <- vectors) {
+        // 分别建模每个带使能的寄存器，覆盖同时推进、
+        // 禁用保持，以及没有新输入时的后级传递。
+        for (_ <- 0 until (if (random.nextBoolean()) 1 else 2)) {
+          val en1 = random.nextInt(4) != 0
+          val en2 = random.nextInt(4) != 0
+          val sum = BigInt(a.zip(b).map { case (x, y) => x * y }.sum) & 0xffffffffL
+          dut.io.vs1.poke(pack(a, BigInt(64, random)).U)
+          dut.io.vs2.poke(pack(b, BigInt(64, random)).U)
+          dut.io.enable(0).poke(en1.B)
+          dut.io.enable(1).poke(en2.B)
+          val next2 = if (en2) stage1 else stage2
+          if (en1) stage1 = Some(sum)
+          dut.clock.step()
+          stage2 = next2
+          stage2.foreach(v => dut.io.result.expect(v.U))
+        }
+      }
+      // 显式检查上界：18 位有符号数无法容纳该结果。
+      dut.io.vs1.poke(pack(Seq.fill(8)(-128), 0).U)
+      dut.io.vs2.poke(pack(Seq.fill(8)(-128), 0).U)
+      dut.io.enable(0).poke(true.B)
+      dut.io.enable(1).poke(false.B)
+      dut.clock.step()
+      dut.io.enable(0).poke(false.B)
+      dut.io.enable(1).poke(true.B)
+      dut.clock.step()
+      dut.io.result.expect(BigInt(131072).U)
+    }
+  }
+
+  it should "hold a negative full-register result while disabled inputs keep changing" in {
+    test(new VDot8).withAnnotations(Seq(VerilatorBackendAnnotation)) { dut =>
+      dut.io.sew16.poke(false.B)
+      dut.io.vs1.poke(pack(Seq.fill(8)(-128), 0).U)
+      dut.io.vs2.poke(pack(Seq.fill(8)(127), 0).U)
+      dut.io.enable(0).poke(true.B)
+      dut.io.enable(1).poke(false.B)
+      dut.clock.step()
+      dut.io.enable(0).poke(false.B)
+      dut.io.enable(1).poke(true.B)
+      dut.clock.step()
+      val expected = BigInt(-130048) & BigInt("ffffffff", 16)
+      dut.io.result.expect(expected.U)
+      dut.io.enable.foreach(_.poke(false.B))
+      val random = new Random(0x484f4c44L)
+      for (_ <- 0 until 96) {
+        dut.io.vs1.poke(BigInt(128, random).U)
+        dut.io.vs2.poke(BigInt(128, random).U)
+        dut.clock.step()
+        dut.io.result.expect(expected.U)
+      }
+      // 第一级禁用保持时，乘积还必须能供后续第二级正确使用。
+      dut.io.enable(1).poke(true.B)
+      dut.clock.step()
+      dut.io.result.expect(expected.U)
+    }
+  }
+
+  it should "switch e8 and e16 with independent stage enables and exact wide endpoints across seeds" in {
+    test(new VDot8).withAnnotations(Seq(VerilatorBackendAnnotation)) { dut =>
+      var s1: Option[BigInt] = None
+      var s2: Option[BigInt] = None
+      for (seed <- Seq(1L, 0x56444f54L, 0x9e3779b9L, 0xdeadbeefL)) {
+        val random = new Random(seed)
+        for (n <- 0 until 520) {
+          val bits = if (n % 2 == 0) 16 else 8
+          val mask = (BigInt(1) << bits) - 1
+          val min = -(1 << (bits - 1))
+          val a = Seq.fill(8)(if (n < 4) min else random.nextInt(1 << bits) + min)
+          val b = Seq.fill(8)(if (n < 2) min else if (n < 4) -min - 1 else random.nextInt(1 << bits) + min)
+          def packed(xs: Seq[Int]): BigInt = xs.zipWithIndex.map {
+            case (v, i) => (BigInt(v) & mask) << (bits * i)
+          }.foldLeft(if (bits == 8) BigInt(64, random) << 64 else BigInt(0))(_ | _)
+          val expected = a.zip(b).map { case (x, y) => BigInt(x) * BigInt(y) }.sum &
+            ((BigInt(1) << (if (bits == 8) 32 else 64)) - 1)
+          val en1 = n < 8 || random.nextInt(4) != 0
+          val en2 = n < 8 || random.nextInt(4) != 0
+          dut.io.sew16.poke((bits == 16).B)
+          dut.io.vs1.poke(packed(a).U)
+          dut.io.vs2.poke(packed(b).U)
+          dut.io.enable(0).poke(en1.B)
+          dut.io.enable(1).poke(en2.B)
+          val next = if (en2) s1 else s2
+          if (en1) s1 = Some(expected)
+          dut.clock.step()
+          s2 = next
+          s2.foreach(v => dut.io.result.expect(v.U))
+        }
+      }
+      dut.io.enable(0).poke(false.B)
+      dut.io.enable(1).poke(true.B)
+      dut.clock.step()
+      s1.foreach(v => dut.io.result.expect(v.U))
+    }
+  }
+}
diff --git a/src/test/scala/xiangshan/backend/fu/vector/VDotIntegrationTest.scala b/src/test/scala/xiangshan/backend/fu/vector/VDotIntegrationTest.scala

@@ -0,0 +1,304 @@
+package xiangshan.backend.fu.vector
+
+import chisel3._
+import chisel3.util._
+import chiseltest._
+import org.chipsalliance.cde.config.Parameters
+import xiangshan._
+import xiangshan.backend.fu.{FuConfig, FuncUnitCtrlInput, FuncUnitDataInput}
+import xiangshan.backend.fu.vector.Bundles.VConfig
+import xiangshan.backend.fu.wrapper.VIMacU
+import yunsuan.VimacType
+
+/** 在 ready 保持为高的条件下，模拟 ExeUnit 固定时间控制与数据流水。 */
+class VDotIntegrationHarness(implicit p: Parameters) extends XSModule {
+  private val cfg = FuConfig.VimacCfg
+  val io = IO(new Bundle {
+    val valid = Input(Bool())
+    val cancel = Input(Bool())
+    val op = Input(UInt(9.W))
+    val tag = Input(UInt(6.W))
+    val vs1 = Input(UInt(128.W))
+    val vs2 = Input(UInt(128.W))
+    val oldVd = Input(UInt(128.W))
+    val mask = Input(UInt(128.W))
+    val vxrm = Input(UInt(2.W))
+    val config = Input(new VConfig)
+    val vm = Input(Bool())
+    val vstart = Input(UInt(8.W))
+    val v0Dest = Input(Bool())
+    val outValid = Output(Bool())
+    val outTag = Output(UInt(8.W))
+    val result = Output(UInt(128.W))
+    val illegal = Output(Bool())
+    val saturated = Output(Bool())
+    val vecWen = Output(Bool())
+    val v0Wen = Output(Bool())
+  })
+  val fu = Module(new VIMacU(cfg))
+  val ctrl = WireInit(0.U.asTypeOf(new FuncUnitCtrlInput(cfg)))
+  ctrl.fuOpType := io.op
+  ctrl.robIdx.value := io.tag
+  ctrl.pdest := io.tag
+  ctrl.vecWen.get := !io.v0Dest
+  ctrl.v0Wen.get := io.v0Dest
+  ctrl.vpu.get.connectVType(io.config.vtype)
+  ctrl.vpu.get.vm := io.vm
+  ctrl.vpu.get.vstart := io.vstart
+  ctrl.vpu.get.lastUop := true.B
+  val data = WireInit(0.U.asTypeOf(new FuncUnitDataInput(cfg)))
+  data.src(0) := io.vs1
+  data.src(1) := io.vs2
+  data.src(2) := io.oldVd
+  data.src(cfg.maskSrcIdx) := io.mask
+  data.src(cfg.vconfigIdx) := io.config.vl
+  val ctrlPipe = ctrl +: Seq.fill(2)(Reg(chiselTypeOf(ctrl)))
+  val dataPipe = data +: Seq.fill(2)(Reg(chiselTypeOf(data)))
+  val validPipe = (io.valid && !io.cancel) +: Seq.fill(2)(RegInit(false.B))
+  for (i <- 1 to 2) {
+    ctrlPipe(i) := ctrlPipe(i - 1)
+    dataPipe(i) := dataPipe(i - 1)
+    validPipe(i) := validPipe(i - 1) && !io.cancel
+  }
+  fu.io.in.bits := 0.U.asTypeOf(fu.io.in.bits)
+  fu.io.in.valid := validPipe.head
+  fu.io.in.bits.ctrl := ctrl
+  fu.io.in.bits.data := data
+  for (i <- 0 to 2) {
+    fu.io.in.bits.ctrlPipe.get(i) := ctrlPipe(i)
+    fu.io.in.bits.dataPipe.get(i) := dataPipe(i)
+    fu.io.in.bits.validPipe.get(i) := validPipe(i)
+  }
+  fu.io.flush.valid := io.cancel
+  fu.io.flush.bits := 0.U.asTypeOf(fu.io.flush.bits)
+  fu.io.out.ready := true.B
+  fu.io.vxrm.foreach(_ := io.vxrm)
+  fu.io.frm.foreach(_ := 0.U)
+  io.outValid := fu.io.out.valid
+  io.outTag := fu.io.out.bits.ctrl.pdest
+  io.result := fu.io.out.bits.res.data
+  io.illegal := fu.io.out.bits.ctrl.exceptionVec.get(ExceptionNO.illegalInstr)
+  io.saturated := fu.io.out.bits.res.vxsat.get.asBool
+  io.vecWen := fu.io.out.bits.ctrl.vecWen.get
+  io.v0Wen := fu.io.out.bits.ctrl.v0Wen.get
+}
+
+class VDotIntegrationTest extends XSTester {
+  behavior of "VIMacU vdot integration"
+  it should "align mixed operations, tags, full writes, runtime legality and canceled operations" in {
+    val testConfig = config.alterPartial {
+      case utility.LogUtilsOptionsKey => utility.LogUtilsOptions(
+        enableDebug = false, enablePerf = false, fpgaPlatform = true)
+    }
+    test(new VDotIntegrationHarness()(testConfig)).withAnnotations(Seq(VerilatorBackendAnnotation, WriteVcdAnnotation)) { dut =>
+      case class Expected(tag: Int, data: BigInt, illegal: Boolean, v0: Boolean)
+      val byteOnes = BigInt("01" * 16, 16)
+      val byteTwos = BigInt("02" * 16, 16)
+      var pending = List.fill[Option[Expected]](2)(None)
+      var issued = 0
+      var checked = 0
+      dut.io.valid.poke(false.B)
+      dut.io.cancel.poke(false.B)
+      dut.io.op.poke(VdotOpType.vdot)
+      dut.io.tag.poke(1.U)
+      dut.io.vs1.poke(byteOnes.U)
+      dut.io.vs2.poke(byteTwos.U)
+      dut.io.oldVd.poke(((BigInt(1) << 128) - 1).U)
+      dut.io.mask.poke(((BigInt(1) << 128) - 1).U)
+      dut.io.vxrm.poke(0.U)
+      dut.io.vm.poke(true.B)
+      dut.io.vstart.poke(0.U)
+      dut.io.v0Dest.poke(false.B)
+      dut.io.config.vtype.illegal.poke(false.B)
+      dut.io.config.vtype.vta.poke(false.B)
+      dut.io.config.vtype.vma.poke(false.B)
+      dut.io.config.vtype.vsew.poke(0.U)
+      dut.io.config.vtype.vlmul.poke(0.U)
+      dut.io.config.vl.poke(8.U)
+      dut.clock.step(3)
+
+      def tick(input: Option[Expected], op: BigInt = 0x160, vl: Int = 8,
+               vm: Boolean = true, start: Int = 0, cancel: Boolean = false,
+               old: BigInt = (BigInt(1) << 128) - 1, sew: Int = 0): Unit = {
+        dut.io.valid.poke(input.nonEmpty.B)
+        dut.io.cancel.poke(cancel.B)
+        dut.io.op.poke(op.U)
+        dut.io.config.vl.poke(vl.U)
+        dut.io.config.vtype.vsew.poke(sew.U)
+        dut.io.vm.poke(vm.B)
+        dut.io.vstart.poke(start.U)
+        dut.io.oldVd.poke(old.U)
+        dut.io.tag.poke(input.map(_.tag).getOrElse(1).U)
+        dut.io.v0Dest.poke(input.exists(_.v0).B)
+        if (cancel) pending = List(None, None)
+        dut.clock.step()
+        pending = input.filter(_ => !cancel) :: pending.take(1)
+        pending(1) match {
+          case Some(e) =>
+            dut.io.outValid.expect(true.B)
+            dut.io.outTag.expect(e.tag.U)
+            dut.io.illegal.expect(e.illegal.B)
+            dut.io.saturated.expect(false.B)
+            dut.io.vecWen.expect((!e.v0).B)
+            dut.io.v0Wen.expect(e.v0.B)
+            if (!e.illegal) dut.io.result.expect(e.data.U)
+            checked += 1
+          case None => dut.io.outValid.expect(false.B)
+        }
+        if (input.nonEmpty) issued += 1
+      }
+      for (i <- 1 to 16) {
+        val isMul = i % 2 == 0
+        dut.io.config.vtype.vta.poke((!isMul && i % 3 == 0).B)
+        dut.io.config.vtype.vma.poke((i % 4 == 0).B)
+        val result = if (isMul) (byteTwos & ((BigInt(1) << 64) - 1)) else BigInt(16)
+        // VL=8、tu 时普通 vmul 保留旧高位字节；点积则必须按自身格式覆盖。
+        tick(Some(Expected(i, result, false, i % 5 == 0)),
+          if (isMul) VimacType.vmul.litValue else BigInt(0x160), old = 0)
+        if (i % 3 == 0) tick(None)
+      }
+      for (vl <- Seq(0, 1, 7, 9, 16)) tick(Some(Expected(20 + vl, 0, true, false)), vl = vl)
+      tick(Some(Expected(40, 0, true, false)), vm = false)
+      tick(Some(Expected(41, 0, true, false)), start = 1)
+      for (vl <- Seq(0, 1, 7, 9)) tick(Some(Expected(50, 0, true, false)), vl = vl, sew = 1)
+      tick(Some(Expected(51, 0, true, false)), sew = 2)
+      tick(Some(Expected(52, 1056784, false, true)), sew = 1)
+      tick(None)
+      tick(None)
+      tick(Some(Expected(42, 16, false, false)))
+      tick(None, cancel = true)
+      tick(None)
+      tick(Some(Expected(43, 16, false, true)))
+      tick(None)
+      tick(None)
+      checked shouldBe issued - 1
+    }
+  }
+
+  it should "preserve randomized mixed traffic and ordinary mask tail multiply accumulate and saturation" in {
+    val testConfig = config.alterPartial {
+      case utility.LogUtilsOptionsKey => utility.LogUtilsOptions(
+        enableDebug = false, enablePerf = false, fpgaPlatform = true)
+    }
+    test(new VDotIntegrationHarness()(testConfig)).withAnnotations(Seq(VerilatorBackendAnnotation, WriteVcdAnnotation)) { dut =>
+      var random = new scala.util.Random(0x49534f4cL)
+      val full = (BigInt(1) << 128) - 1
+      case class Expected(tag: Int, result: BigInt, saturated: Boolean)
+      var pending = List.fill[Option[Expected]](2)(None)
+      var checked = 0
+      var issued = 0
+      var killed = 0
+
+      def signed(x: BigInt, width: Int): BigInt =
+        if (x.testBit(width - 1)) x - (BigInt(1) << width) else x
+
+      def tick(kind: String, sew: Int = 8, valid: Boolean = true, cancel: Boolean = false,
+               forceSat: Boolean = false): Unit = {
+        val dot = kind == "dot"
+        val width = sew
+        val count = 128 / width
+        val elemMask = (BigInt(1) << width) - 1
+        val a = if (forceSat) BigInt("80" * 16, 16) else BigInt(128, random)
+        val b = if (forceSat) a else BigInt(128, random)
+        val old = BigInt(128, random)
+        val mask = BigInt(128, random)
+        val vl = if (dot) 8 else if (forceSat) count else random.nextInt(count + 1)
+        val vm = dot || forceSat || random.nextBoolean()
+        val ta = random.nextBoolean()
+        val ma = random.nextBoolean()
+        val tag = issued % 63 + 1
+        val op = kind match {
+          case "dot" => VdotOpType.vdot
+          case "mul" => VimacType.vmul
+          case "macc" => VimacType.vmacc
+          case "madd" => VimacType.vmadd
+          case "nmsac" => VimacType.vnmsac
+          case "smul" => VimacType.vsmul
+        }
+        var sat = false
+        val result = if (dot) {
+          (0 until 8).map { i =>
+            signed((a >> (width * i)) & elemMask, width) * signed((b >> (width * i)) & elemMask, width)
+          }.sum & ((BigInt(1) << (if (width == 8) 32 else 64)) - 1)
+        } else {
+          (0 until count).map { i =>
+            val x = signed((a >> (width * i)) & elemMask, width)
+            val y = signed((b >> (width * i)) & elemMask, width)
+            val z = (old >> (width * i)) & elemMask
+            val active = i < vl && (vm || mask.testBit(i))
+            val product = kind match {
+              case "mul" => x * y
+              case "macc" => x * y + z
+              case "madd" => x * signed(z, width) + y
+              case "nmsac" => z - x * y
+              case "smul" =>
+                val overflow = x == -(BigInt(1) << (width - 1)) && x == y
+                if (active && overflow) sat = true
+                if (overflow) (BigInt(1) << (width - 1)) - 1 else (x * y) >> (width - 1)
+            }
+            // vstart 不小于 VL 时，即使选择 ta/ma，普通指令仍保留整个目的寄存器。
+            val value = if (vl == 0) z else if (active) product & elemMask
+              else if ((i >= vl && ta) || (i < vl && ma)) elemMask else z
+            value << (width * i)
+          }.foldLeft(BigInt(0))(_ | _)
+        }
+        dut.io.valid.poke(valid.B)
+        dut.io.cancel.poke(cancel.B)
+        dut.io.op.poke(op)
+        dut.io.tag.poke(tag.U)

+  int64_t sum = 0;

+  vreg_l(id_dest->reg, 0) = bits == 8 ? (uint64_t)(uint32_t)sum : (uint64_t)sum;
+  vreg_l(id_dest->reg, 1) = 0;
+  vstart->val = 0;
+  vp_set_dirty();
